recipes.description: Indulge in the fusion of flavors with this Butter Chicken Sandwich, featuring crispy chicken strips coated in a spiced flour mixture with curry powder that ignites your palate. Pan-fried to golden perfection, the tender chicken is a mouthwatering twist on a classic favorite. This sandwich promises a tantalizing taste experience that will have you craving more!

recipes.title: Cool Cole Slaw
directions: In a large bowl, combine the red cabbage, green cabbage, grated carrots, and chopped onions.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, apple cider vinegar, celery seed, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Pour the dressing over the cabbage mixture and toss until everything is well coated.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld.
Before serving, give the slaw a good stir and adjust seasoning with more salt and pepper if needed.
recipes.description: Cool Cole Slaw is a refreshing medley of vibrant red and green cabbage, crunchy carrots, and sweet onions, all tossed in a creamy dressing made with mayonnaise and tangy apple cider vinegar. The addition of celery seed adds a subtle crunch and earthiness that complements the crisp vegetables beautifully. This slaw is not just a side; it’s a crunchy, vibrant delight that perfectly complements any meal!

recipes.title: Bacon Onion and Roasted Garlic Jam
directions: In a large skillet over medium heat, cook the diced bacon until crispy, about 8-10 minutes. Remove bacon with a slotted spoon and set aside, leaving the bacon fat in the skillet.
Add the diced onions to the skillet and reduce the heat to low. Cook the onions slowly, stirring occasionally, until they are deeply caramelized, about 30-40 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Add the brown sugar, apple cider vinegar, and bourbon maple syrup to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Return the crispy bacon to the skillet and let the mixture simmer on low for about 15-20 minutes, or until it thickens to a jammy consistency.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Let the jam cool slightly before transferring to a jar. It will thicken more as it rests.
recipes.description: Transform your dishes with this Bacon Onion and Roasted Garlic Jam, a sweet and savory spread that combines crispy bacon with slowly caramelized onions and rich garlic. The layers of flavor create a symphony on your palate, making it the perfect accompaniment for cheese boards or sandwiches. Once you taste it, you'll be hooked on its irresistible richness!

recipes.title: Creamed Spinach
ingredients: 1 pound fresh spinach, washed and chopped
directions: In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped spinach to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the cream cheese and heavy cream, mixing until the cream cheese is completely melted and incorporated.
Add the grated Parmesan cheese, salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes, stirring until everything is well combined and heated through.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.
Serve warm as a delicious side dish.
recipes.description: Creamed Spinach is the ultimate indulgent side dish, featuring fresh spinach sautéed with fragrant garlic and enveloped in a silky cream cheese and heavy cream sauce. The combination of flavors makes each bite a comforting delight, perfect for elevating any meal. This creamy, luscious dish is sure to become a favorite at your dinner table!

recipes.title: Creamy Greek Lemon Herb Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
1/4 cup sour cream or Greek yogurt
directions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) if roasting the potatoes.
In a large pot, combine the Yukon Gold potatoes, chicken broth, and enough water to cover them. Bring to a boil and cook until fork-tender, about 15-20 minutes. Drain and set aside.

In a mixing bowl, whisk together the olive oil, fresh lemon juice, sour cream or Greek yogurt, minced garlic, diced red onion, rosemary, thyme, Italian seasoning, chicken bouillon, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
If roasting, spread the cooked potatoes on a baking sheet, pour the herb mixture over them, and toss to coat. Roast in the oven for about 15 minutes until golden and crispy.
If boiling, return the potatoes to the pot, add the herb mixture, and gently stir to coat the potatoes in the creamy sauce.
Adjust seasoning to taste, adding more salt, pepper, or lemon juice if desired.
Serve warm, and if you’ve roasted chicken thighs, feel free to mix in some of the chicken drippings for extra flavor. Enjoy!
recipes.description: These Creamy Greek Lemon Herb Potatoes are a delightful side dish featuring Yukon Gold potatoes, infused with zesty fresh lemon juice, aromatic olive oil, and fragrant herbs. The combination of chicken broth and rich olive oil creates a velvety texture that's simply irresistible. Elevate your meals with this creamy, tangy, and herbaceous dish that will have everyone asking for seconds!

recipes.title: Mediterranean White Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup skinless cucumber, dehydrated and rehydrated
directions: In a bowl, combine the Greek yogurt, mayonnaise or sour cream, olive oil, and lemon juice until smooth.
Add the rehydrated cucumber, roasted garlic, white onion, parsley, za'atar seasoning, and black pepper to the bowl.
If using, stir in the fresh mint.
Mix all ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed, adding more salt or lemon juice if desired.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld before serving.
recipes.description: This Mediterranean White Sauce is a luscious blend of Greek yogurt, creamy mayonnaise, and zesty lemon juice, combined with refreshing rehydrated cucumber and roasted garlic. Infused with fragrant parsley and za'atar seasoning, it delivers a burst of flavor that’s perfect for drizzling or dipping. This sauce is a must-have accompaniment that will elevate your culinary creations to a whole new level!

recipes.title: Mexican Creamy Bean Sauce
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) full fat refried beans
1 cup Cjota cheese or goat cheese, crumbled
2 tablespoons Cholula hot sauce (or to taste)
directions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the refried beans, sour cream, and mayonnaise until smooth.
Stir in the crumbled Cjota cheese (or goat cheese), diced green chilies, chopped pickled jalapeños, Cholula hot sauce, lime juice, taco seasoning, and black pepper.
If using, add the oregano and Taco Bell sauce to the mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a saucepan over medium heat and cook for about 10-15 minutes, stirring regularly until heated through.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed, adding more hot sauce or lime juice if you like it spicier or tangier.
Serve warm over tacos, nachos, or as a dip with tortilla chips.
recipes.description: Dive into the vibrant flavors of this Mexican Creamy Bean Sauce, where creamy refried beans meet tangy lime juice, rich sour cream, and spicy Cholula hot sauce. The addition of crumbled Cotija cheese and pickled jalapeños adds layers of texture and zestiness that will tantalize your taste buds. Perfect for tacos or as a dip, this sauce is a fiesta of flavors that will spice up any meal!

recipes.title: Fresh and Crisp Garden Chicken Wrap
ingredients: 1/4 cup In-N-Out sauce or Ken's Thousand Island dressing
4 tomato basil wraps or large flour tortillas
directions: In a large bowl, combine the shredded rotisserie chicken, diced red and green apples, sliced white onion, pickled red onions, crushed tortilla chips, and garlic herb seasoning.
In a separate small bowl, mix together the sour cream, mayonnaise, and In-N-Out sauce or Thousand Island dressing until well combined.
Pour the dressing mixture over the chicken and apple mixture, and toss everything together until evenly coated.
If using, stir in the cooked white rice for added heartiness.
Lay out your tomato basil wraps or flour tortillas on a flat surface.
Divide the chicken mixture evenly among the wraps, then roll them up tightly.
Slice the wraps in half and serve cold, or chill in the fridge until ready to eat.
recipes.description: The Fresh and Crisp Garden Chicken Wrap combines tender shredded rotisserie chicken with a medley of diced apples, tangy pickled red onions, and crunchy tortilla chips. Dressed in a creamy mixture of sour cream and In-N-Out sauce, this wrap is a delightful balance of savory and sweet. Enjoy a satisfying, fresh bite that’s perfect for lunch or a light dinner, and experience the joyous crunch in every mouthful!

recipes.title: Lemon Rosemary Chicken Rice
directions: Step 1: In a large skillet, sear the chicken thighs over medium-high heat until cooked through, about 6-8 minutes per side. Remove the chicken and save the grease in the pan.

Step 2: In the same pan, add the basmati rice, 1/4 cup lemon juice, and enough chicken stock (about 3 cups total) to cover the rice. Bring to a simmer, then cover and cook for about 15-20 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Step 3: While the rice cooks, shred or chop the cooked chicken thighs, keeping the skin on.

Step 4: Pour the remaining chicken stock into the skillet used for the chicken. Add the diced onion, minced garlic, and diced red pepper. Sauté for about 5 minutes until the vegetables are soft and the brown bits are deglazed.
Step 5: Fold the cooked rice and chopped chicken into the skillet with the sautéed veggies and broth, mixing well.
Step 6: Season the mixture with lemon pepper, extra lemon juice, plenty of rosemary, parsley, and mint. Stir to combine.
Step 7: Simmer for an additional 5 minutes until heated through and flavors meld. Serve warm topped with sour cream and pickled red onions.
recipes.description: Savor the delightful combination of juicy chicken thighs and fragrant basmati rice in this Lemon Rosemary Chicken Rice dish. Infused with fresh lemon juice and seasoned with aromatic rosemary, every bite bursts with flavor, complemented by the richness of chicken stock. It’s a comforting, one-pan meal that promises to impress at your dinner table, making weeknight cooking a breeze!

recipes.title: Goat Cheese and Spinach Scrambled Eggs
directions: In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped spinach and halved cherry tomatoes to the skillet, cooking until the spinach is wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
In a bowl, crack the eggs and whisk until well combined. Pour the eggs into the skillet with the veggies and stir gently to scramble.
As the eggs start to set, add the crumbled goat cheese and continue to stir until the eggs are fully cooked and the cheese is melted, about 3-5 minutes.
If using, sprinkle the shredded pepper jack cheese on top and let it melt slightly.
Serve the scrambled eggs hot, topped with a dollop of sour cream and pickled red onions, or on buttered sourdough bread if you prefer.
recipes.description: Start your day with a delightful twist on classic scrambled eggs, featuring creamy goat cheese and fresh spinach. The rich goat cheese adds a tangy depth, while sautéed onions and garlic infuse every bite with savory goodness. Perfectly seasoned, this dish is a breakfast dream that will elevate your morning routine!

recipes.title: Special Italian Sandwich Sauce
directions: Start by roasting 4 cloves of garlic, 1 red bell pepper, and 1/2 of a red onion until charred and tender. Let them cool, then chop.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the pepperoncini juice, red vinegar, mayonnaise, lemon juice, yellow mustard, Italian herbs, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Add the roasted garlic, bell pepper, and onion to the sauce mixture, stirring until well incorporated.
Fold in the salami, pepperoni, sun-dried tomatoes, sliced pepperoncini, and pickled red onions until evenly distributed.
If the sauce is too thick, add more mayonnaise, vinegar, or pepperoncini juice until you reach your desired consistency.
Serve this sauce drizzled over sandwiches, or use it as a tasty dip for your favorite snacks.
recipes.description: Transform your sandwiches with this zesty Italian sandwich sauce that bursts with flavor! With roasted garlic, sweet red bell pepper, and a touch of tangy pepperoncini juice, this sauce is a blend of savory and spicy. It brings life to any meal, making your taste buds dance and leaving you craving more!

recipes.title: Homemade Tallow/Butter Mayonnaise
directions: In a blender, combine the raw eggs, melted tallow or butter, olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, and salt.
Blend on high speed until the mixture is emulsified and creamy, about 30 seconds.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, adding more salt or lemon juice to your liking.
Transfer the mayonnaise to a clean jar and store in the refrigerator.
recipes.description: Elevate your condiment game with this rich and creamy homemade mayonnaise made from tallow or butter. Blending raw eggs with zesty lemon juice and Dijon mustard creates a perfect emulsion that's both luscious and satisfying. Perfect for slathering on sandwiches or as a dip, this mayo offers a delightful twist that will have you obsessed!

recipes.title: Red Creamy Chimichurri Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup roasted red bell peppers, chopped
directions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) and roast the red bell peppers until charred, about 20-25 minutes. Let them cool and then peel off the skin.
In a mixing bowl, combine the chopped parsley, cilantro, roasted garlic, chopped roasted red bell peppers, and red onion.
Add the olive oil, lemon juice, red wine vinegar, red pepper flakes, and salt to the bowl and mix well.
In a small saucepan, melt the butter over low heat, then stir it into the sauce mixture.
Finally, fold in the mayonnaise or sour cream for creaminess. Adjust seasoning to taste.
Serve the sauce with grilled meats, veggies, or as a zesty dip!
recipes.description: Dive into a vibrant world of flavors with this red creamy chimichurri sauce, packed with roasted red bell peppers and fresh herbs. The smoky sweetness of the peppers combined with zesty lemon juice and fragrant garlic creates an irresistible dip or marinade. It's a bold accompaniment that will elevate any dish to new culinary heights!

recipes.title: Classic Chili
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) kidney beans, drained and rinsed
Shredded pepper jack cheese, for serving
directions: In a large pot, brown the ground beef and diced pork belly over medium heat until fully cooked. Drain excess fat.
Add the chopped white and red onions, and minced garlic to the pot. Sauté until the onions are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the corn, bell pepper, diced tomatoes, sauerkraut, kidney beans, chili seasoning, tomato paste, and beef broth. Mix well.
Bring the chili to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and let it cook for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Serve hot, topped with sour cream, shredded pepper jack cheese, chopped green onions, and a side of Fritos.
recipes.description: Warm up with a hearty bowl of chili that's a flavor explosion in every spoonful! Featuring ground beef, diced pork belly, and a medley of fresh vegetables like corn and bell peppers, this dish is both comforting and satisfying. Each bite offers a savory richness, making it the perfect dish for cozy nights or gatherings with friends.

recipes.title: Garlic Herb Butter
directions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) and roast the garlic for about 30 minutes until soft.
In a mixing bowl, combine the softened butter, chopped parsley, minced roasted garlic, chopped thyme, chopped rosemary, and lemon juice.
Mix everything together until well combined, using a fork or spatula.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, adding a pinch of salt or more herbs to your liking.
Transfer the garlic herb butter to a piece of parchment paper, roll it into a log, and twist the ends to seal.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to firm up before using, or keep in the freezer for later.
recipes.description: This Garlic Herb Butter is a decadent blend of rich, softened butter infused with roasted garlic and fresh herbs. Key ingredients like aromatic thyme, rosemary, and a splash of lemon juice elevate it to a flavorful experience that’s perfect for spreading on warm bread or melting over grilled steaks. Each bite bursts with a robust, savory flavor that will leave you craving more!

recipes.title: Creamy Horseradish Sauce
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine the sour cream, mayonnaise, horseradish, minced garlic, and chopped red onions.
Add the lemon juice, red wine vinegar, black pepper, and salt to the mixture.
If using, stir in the fresh dill and raw egg for extra creaminess.
Melt the butter in a small saucepan over low heat, then pour it into the sauce mixture.
Mix everything until well combined and smooth.
Taste the sauce and adjust seasoning, adding more salt, pepper, or horseradish as desired.
Refrigerate the sauce for at least 30 minutes before serving to let the flavors meld.
recipes.description: Creamy Horseradish Sauce is a zesty condiment combining sour cream and mayonnaise with the bold heat of horseradish. The addition of minced garlic and crisp red onions creates a delightful complexity, while a splash of lemon juice brightens every bite. This sauce adds a fiery kick to any dish, making it an irresistible accompaniment for meats and seafood alike!

recipes.title: Pimping Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup Kalamata olives, pitted and sliced
directions: Cook the tri-color rigatoni and tri-color orzo pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and let cool.
While the pasta is cooling, prepare the roasted garlic by removing the cloves from the head and mashing them with a fork.
In a large bowl, combine the cooled pasta, shredded Pepper Jack cheese, crumbled feta, Kalamata olives, red onion, red bell pepper, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, pepperoni, salami, and fresh basil.
In a separate small bowl, mix together the roasted garlic, Italian seasoning, Italian or Greek dressing, lemon juice, and black pepper.
Pour the dressing mixture over the pasta salad and toss everything together until well coated.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld together.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
recipes.description: Pimping Pasta Salad is a vibrant medley that takes your taste buds on a delightful journey with tri-color rigatoni and orzo. Loaded with shredded pepper jack cheese, roasted garlic, and fresh veggies, this dish is dressed in a light yet tangy vinaigrette. The combination of textures and flavors makes it a perfect side or a light meal that’s both refreshing and satisfying!

recipes.title: Fantastic Fried Rice
directions: In a large skillet or wok, heat the toasted sesame oil over medium-high heat.
Add the diced red onion, carrots, and bell peppers. Stir-fry for about 5 minutes until they start to soften.
Stir in the peas, corn, and cucumber, and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Add the day-old basmati rice, breaking up any clumps, and mix well with the vegetables.
Sprinkle in the chicken bouillon, soy sauce, lemon juice, chili garlic paste, and crispy chili oil. Stir well to combine and heat through, about 5 minutes.
Fold in the roasted garlic and chopped roasted peanuts just before serving.
Top with chopped green onions for garnish and serve hot.
recipes.description: Fantastic Fried Rice is a colorful stir-fry that brings together day-old basmati rice with an array of fresh vegetables like diced red onions, carrots, and bell peppers. Stir-fried in toasted sesame oil, each ingredient harmonizes beautifully, creating a satisfying crunch and umami flavor. This dish is not only a fantastic way to use leftovers, but it also offers a deliciously addictive experience that will have you coming back for seconds!

recipes.title: Perfect Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and diced
directions: Boil the diced Yukon Gold potatoes in chicken stock until fork-tender, about 15-20 minutes. Drain and let cool.
In a large bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, heavy mayonnaise, sour cream, and honey mustard vinaigrette. Mix until smooth.
Add the cooled potatoes to the bowl, along with the Cheddar cheese, red onions, green onions, hard-boiled eggs, sweet relish, celery, crispy bacon, and red bell peppers.
Sprinkle in the red pepper flakes and paprika, and gently fold everything together until well combined.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper as needed.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving to let the flavors meld together.
recipes.description: Perfect Potato Salad combines tender Yukon Gold potatoes boiled in savory chicken stock with a creamy blend of cream cheese, mayonnaise, and honey mustard vinaigrette. The sharpness of Cheddar cheese adds depth, while the smooth dressing ties it all together. This indulgent side dish is perfect for picnics and barbecues, promising a rich, creamy flavor that delights with every bite!

recipes.title: Sexy Street Corn Salad
directions: Preheat a grill or skillet over medium-high heat. Add the husked corn and cook, turning occasionally, until lightly charred on all sides, about 10-15 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool.
While the corn is cooling, cook the chorizo in a skillet over medium heat until browned and cooked through, then set aside.
Once the corn is cool enough to handle, cut the kernels off the cob and place them in a large mixing bowl.
Add the red onion, green onion, roasted jalapeño, cilantro, cotija cheese, feta cheese, Parmesan cheese, mayonnaise, sour cream, and lime juice and pulp to the bowl with the corn.
Stir in the cooked chorizo and melted butter, mixing everything together until well combined. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately or chill in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes to let the flavors meld together.
recipes.description: This Sexy Street Corn Salad is a vibrant twist on traditional elote, highlighting charred corn. Key ingredients like smoky chorizo, zesty lime juice, and fresh cilantro elevate its flavor profile. The combination of sweet corn and spicy chorizo creates a mouthwatering balance that will have you craving seconds!

recipes.title: Crazy Mac n Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 cup chives or green onions, chopped
directions: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C).
Cook the cellentani pasta according to package instructions until al dente, then drain and set aside.
In a large pot, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and diced red onion, cooking until softened and fragrant, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the flour and cook for another minute, then gradually add in the sharp cheddar, Parmesan, ricotta, pepper jack, and goat cheese, stirring until melted and creamy.
Add the cooked pasta, sun-dried tomatoes, diced red bell pepper, chopped chives or green onions, crispy mini pepperoni, and crumbled bacon. Mix everything together until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a greased baking dish and top with crushed Cool Ranch Doritos.
Bake in the preheated oven for about 20 minutes, or until bubbly and golden on top. Let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
recipes.description: Dive into the creamy indulgence of Crazy Mac n Cheese, a comforting pasta dish loaded with cellentani pasta. Enhanced by rich melted cheddar, savory garlic, and sweet red onion, each bite is a delightful explosion of flavor. This mac and cheese is the ultimate cheesy, gooey experience that will elevate any meal into a feast!

recipes.title: Crispy Asian Chili Mayo
ingredients: Optional: 1/4 cup Thai sweet chili sauce
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine the chili crisp, mayonnaise, minced garlic, chopped shallots, and sliced green onions.
Mix well until all the ingredients are fully incorporated.
Add black pepper to taste and stir again.
If you want a touch of sweetness, mix in the Thai sweet chili sauce, if using.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, adding more black pepper or chili crisp for extra heat.
Serve immediately or refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld.
recipes.description: Crispy Asian Chili Mayo is a bold and flavorful condiment that marries creamy mayonnaise with the heat of chili crisp. With minced garlic, chopped shallots, and a touch of sweet Thai chili sauce, this dip packs a punch in every bite. Perfect for drizzling over tacos or as a zesty dip, it’s a must-try for spice lovers!

recipes.title: Better Cowboy Butter
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine the mayonnaise, softened butter, and Dijon mustard until smooth.
Stir in the lemon juice, minced garlic, roasted garlic, and red onion until well mixed.
Add the parsley, thyme, rosemary, smoked paprika, red pepper flakes, and black pepper, mixing until everything is evenly distributed.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, adding more lemon juice or spices to suit your preference.
Transfer the Cowboy Butter to an airtight container and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld together.
Serve chilled or at room temperature as a spread for grilled meats, veggies, or bread.
recipes.description: Better Cowboy Butter is a luscious compound butter that combines mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, and roasted garlic for an irresistible dip. Infused with fresh herbs like parsley and thyme, along with a kick of smoked paprika, this sauce adds a savory depth to grilled meats and vegetables. Elevate your BBQ game with this flavor-packed spread!

recipes.title: Cilantro Lime Sauce
directions: In a medium bowl, combine the mayonnaise and Greek yogurt until smooth.
Add the chopped cilantro, minced garlic, lime juice, salt, and pepper to the bowl.
Stir the mixture until all ingredients are well combined.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, adding more salt or lime juice to your liking.
Transfer the sauce to a serving dish or store in an airtight container in the refrigerator until ready to use.
recipes.description: Cilantro Lime Sauce is a zesty and creamy dressing that brings freshness to any dish, featuring a blend of mayonnaise and Greek yogurt. With bright lime juice and fragrant cilantro, it offers a tangy kick that perfectly complements tacos, grilled chicken, or salads. This sauce is a vibrant addition that will awaken your taste buds!

recipes.title: Special Steak Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup gravy and fat from cooked steak
directions: In a skillet over medium heat, melt the butter and sauté the minced shallots until they're translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the roasted and charred garlic, red bell pepper, and red onion to the skillet and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
In a mixing bowl, combine the sautéed mixture with A1 Sauce, mayonnaise, pepperoncini juice, lemon juice, gravy and fat from the steak, and beef bouillon.
If using, add Dijon mustard, horseradish, and minced jalapeno to the bowl and mix well.
Stir in fresh thyme, parsley, rosemary, salt, and coarse black pepper.
Simmer the sauce over low heat for about 10-15 minutes to let the flavors meld together.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed before serving it warm over your favorite steak.
recipes.description: This Special Steak Sauce elevates your favorite cuts with a rich blend of A1 Sauce, roasted garlic, and sautéed shallots. The tangy depth from red bell pepper and onion adds a vibrant kick that complements meat perfectly. Drizzle it on your steak for a mouthwatering explosion of flavors that will leave you craving more!

recipes.title: Ranch Sauce
directions: In a medium bowl, combine the mayonnaise, sour cream, and heavy cream until smooth.
Add the ranch seasoning mix, dried dill, paprika, salt, pepper, grated garlic, dehydrated red onion, and dehydrated cucumber to the bowl.
Stir everything together until well combined.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld.
Before serving, taste and adjust the seasoning if needed.
recipes.description: Ranch Sauce is a creamy, tangy dip made with a luscious mixture of mayonnaise, sour cream, and heavy cream. The addition of ranch seasoning, paprika, and fresh herbs like dill creates an irresistible flavor profile. Perfect for dipping veggies or slathering on sandwiches, this sauce is sure to be a crowd-pleaser at any gathering!

recipes.title: Creamy Al Pastor Sauce
ingredients: 2 dried guajillo chiles, seeds removed and chopped
directions: In a skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and add the diced red onion and minced garlic. Sauté until the onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped guajillo chiles, ancho chile paste, adobo sauce, and oregano to the skillet. Stir and cook for another 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
In a mixing bowl, combine the sour cream, pork bouillon, orange juice, diced pineapple, and the sautéed mixture from the skillet. Stir until well combined.
Add the chopped cilantro and cotija cheese, mixing gently to combine. Adjust seasoning to taste.
Simmer the sauce over low heat for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally to blend the flavors.
Serve warm over tacos, grilled meats, or as a dip!
recipes.description: Creamy Al Pastor Sauce is a vibrant, spiced sauce featuring sautéed red onions and garlic, combined with rich guajillo chiles and adobo sauce. The fragrant oregano brings everything together, making it the perfect topping for tacos or grilled meats. Its bold flavors will transport your taste buds straight to a Mexican street food paradise!

recipes.title: Habanero Pizza Ranch Aioli
ingredients: 1 orange bell pepper, roasted and chopped
directions: In a medium bowl, combine the mayonnaise, sour cream, dill, ranch seasoning mix, minced garlic, chopped Habenareo pepper, diced pepperoni, and black pepper.
Mix well until all the ingredients are thoroughly combined.
In a small skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the roasted orange bell pepper and red onion to the skillet and sauté for about 5 minutes until warmed through.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly, then fold the roasted veggies into the aioli mixture.
Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary, adding more ranch seasoning or black pepper as desired.
Serve immediately or chill in the refrigerator until ready to use.
recipes.description: Get ready for a flavor explosion with Habenareo Pizza Ranch Aoli, a spicy twist on the classic ranch sauce. This zesty concoction combines mayonnaise, sour cream, and minced garlic with the fiery kick of Habenareo pepper and savory pepperoni. Perfect for drizzling over pizza or as a bold dipping sauce, it will ignite your culinary creativity!

recipes.title: Mexican Street Corn Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili lime seasoning or Tajín
directions: In a skillet over medium heat, cook the chorizo until browned and crumbly. Remove from heat and set aside.

In a large bowl, combine the Cotija cheese, Fresco cheese, mayonnaise, sour cream, yogurt, lime juice, chili lime seasoning, taco seasoning, roasted corn, roasted red peppers, red onion, garlic, and jalapeño.
Add the cooked chorizo to the mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the sauce to a saucepan and heat over low heat for about 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally until warmed through.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed, adding more lime juice or seasoning if desired.
Serve warm as a dip with tortilla chips or as a topping for tacos, grilled meats, or veggies.
recipes.description: Mexican Street Corn Sauce is a creamy, zesty blend that captures the essence of elote in every bite. With Cotija and Fresco cheese, roasted corn, and a hint of lime juice, this sauce is rich and refreshing. It's the ultimate topping for tacos, grilled meats, or simply as a dip, bringing the street food experience right to your kitchen!

recipes.title: Marry Me Chicken Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon stone ground mustard or whole grain mustard seed (optional)
directions: In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook until soft, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic, chopped green onions, and diced red bell pepper. Cook for another 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Add the sun-dried tomatoes, lemon juice, and white wine to the skillet, scraping up any browned bits on the bottom. Simmer for about 5 minutes.
Pour in the chicken stock and heavy cream, then add the chicken bouillon, cayenne pepper, smoked paprika, Italian herbs, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, then reduce heat to low and stir in the chopped basil and grated Parmesan cheese. Cook for another 5 minutes until the sauce thickens.
If using, stir in the stone ground mustard for an extra kick. Adjust seasoning to taste.
Serve the sauce over cooked chicken, pasta, or rice, and enjoy!
recipes.description: Marry Me Chicken sauce is a luscious blend of flavors that elevates any dish to romantic heights. With sun-dried tomatoes, zesty lemon juice, and a splash of white wine, this sauce tantalizes the palate while the buttery goodness brings it all together. It's a delightful way to impress your loved ones and make every meal feel special!

recipes.title: Goat Cheese Kahlua Hot Sauce
ingredients: 2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, minced
directions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Roast the garlic by wrapping it in foil and placing it in the oven for about 30 minutes until soft.
In a mixing bowl, combine the softened goat cheese and cream cheese until smooth.
Add the Chalua hot sauce, green chilies, chipotle peppers, serrano peppers, roasted garlic (squeezed out of their skins), olive oil, butter, and lemon juice to the bowl. Mix well.
Stir in the thyme, rosemary, oregano, black pepper, and salt until everything is well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a small saucepan and heat over medium-low heat for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally until warmed through.
Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary, adding more salt or hot sauce as desired.
Serve warm as a dip or drizzle over your favorite dishes.
recipes.description: This Goat Cheese Chaluah Hot Sauce is a creamy, spicy dip that packs a punch. Infused with robust Chalua hot sauce, roasted garlic, and zesty green chilies, it’s a flavor explosion that enhances everything from tacos to grilled meats. Whip it up for your next gathering and watch it disappear in a flash!

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Cream Cheese Sauce
directions: In a skillet over medium heat, melt the butter.
Add the roasted garlic, red onion, and red bell pepper to the skillet and sauté until the vegetables are soft, about 5 minutes.
Reduce the heat to low, then stir in the cream cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the Red Hot hot sauce, chicken tomato bouillon, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until fully combined.
Let the sauce simmer for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed, adding more salt or hot sauce to your preference.
Serve warm as a dip or over chicken, pasta, or veggies.
recipes.description: The Buffalo Chicken Cream Cheese Sauce is a velvety blend that brings all the classic flavors of buffalo wings to your table. With the kick of Red Hot hot sauce, creamy melted cream cheese, and savory roasted garlic, it's a dip that satisfies cravings in every bite. Perfect for game day or cozy gatherings, it’s an irresistible treat!

recipes.title: Magical Marry Me Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon stone ground mustard or whole grain mustard seed
directions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, potato or corn starch, cayenne pepper, garlic salt, Italian seasoning, lemon zest, and black pepper. Dredge the chicken thighs in this mixture, then dip in the beaten eggs.
In a large skillet, heat a mix of butter and avocado oil over medium heat. Add the chicken thighs and cook until golden brown on both sides, about 5-7 minutes per side. Remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the chopped bacon (if using) and cook until crispy. Add the onions, garlic, and red bell pepper, cooking until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, chicken stock, white wine, lemon juice, and chicken bouillon. Bring to a simmer, then add the heavy cream and smoked paprika. Cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Return the chicken to the skillet, cover, and let it simmer on low for about 10 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.
Meanwhile, cook the angel hair pasta according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Stir in the chopped basil and grated Parmesan cheese into the sauce. Adjust seasoning with black pepper as needed.
Serve the chicken and sauce over the angel hair pasta and with garlic bread on the side.
recipes.description: Magical Marry Me Chicken is a delectable dish that transforms ordinary chicken thighs into culinary magic. Encrusted with a fragrant blend of garlic salt, Italian seasoning, and zesty lemon zest, and sautéed to perfection, each bite is bursting with flavor. This dish is not just a meal; it’s a heartfelt experience that’s sure to win over anyone’s heart!

recipes.title: Green Chile Stew
directions: In a large pot, brown the ground beef over medium heat until fully cooked, about 5-7 minutes. Drain any excess fat.
Add the diced jalapeño to the pot and cook for another 2-3 minutes until softened.
Stir in the cream cheese, Mexican hot sauce, corn, chipotle, and sour cream. Mix until the cream cheese is fully melted and incorporated.
Add the Beef Stroganoff Hamburger Helper and 4 cups of water to the pot. Stir well to combine all ingredients.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let it cook for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until everything is heated through and the flavors meld.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, adding more hot sauce for extra kick if desired.
Serve hot, garnished with additional jalapeños or cheese if you like!
recipes.description: Green Chile soup is a hearty, comforting dish that warms the soul. Featuring flavorful ground beef, spicy jalapeños, and creamy chipotle-infused cream cheese, it melds spicy and savory notes in each spoonful. This soup is a cozy delight that’s perfect for chilly nights or a hearty lunch!

recipes.title: Chili Oils
directions: In a small saucepan, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat until hot but not smoking.
Add the red pepper flakes and Sichuan peppercorns to the hot oil, and stir for about 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the minced garlic and ginger, cooking for an additional 1-2 minutes until golden.
Remove the saucepan from heat and let the oil cool slightly.
If using, stir in the soy sauce and sesame oil for extra flavor.
Strain the oil through a fine mesh sieve into a clean jar or container, discarding the solids.
Let the chili oil cool completely before sealing it up. Store in the refrigerator for up to a month.
recipes.description: Transform ordinary meals with this homemade chili oil, a fragrant blend of sizzling vegetable oil infused with red pepper flakes and Sichuan peppercorns. The delightful aroma of minced garlic and ginger brings a warmth that tantalizes the senses. Drizzle this spicy concoction over your dishes for an irresistible heat that will leave everyone craving more!

recipes.title: Cheesy Potato Bites
directions: In a large bowl, combine the mashed potatoes, shredded cheddar cheese, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined.
Shape the potato mixture into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Dredge each ball in flour, dip in beaten eggs, and coat with breadcrumbs. Set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat. Fry the potato balls in batches until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side. Remove and drain on paper towels.
In another skillet, cook the diced bacon over medium heat until crispy. Add the chopped onions and garlic, and sauté until onions are translucent.
Add the chopped cabbage to the skillet and cook until wilted and tender, about 8-10 minutes. Drizzle with balsamic glaze if using.
Serve the cheesy potato balls alongside the fried cabbage for a delightful appetizer spread.
recipes.description: Indulge in these crispy potato balls, where creamy mashed potatoes meet shredded cheddar cheese for an explosion of flavor. Seasoned with garlic and onion powder, each ball is coated in breadcrumbs for a perfectly golden crunch. Perfect as an appetizer or snack, these bites are simply irresistible and will have your guests reaching for more!

recipes.title: Classic Chicken Sandwich Sauces
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pickle juice or lemon juice
1/2 cup pickles, chopped (or 1/4 cup dill relish)
directions: In a skillet, heat the bacon fat over medium heat.
Add the diced red onion and minced garlic, cooking until slightly crispy, about 5-7 minutes. If using, add the chopped red bell pepper or poblano pepper and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
In a mixing bowl, combine the mayonnaise, pickle juice or lemon juice, salt, pepper, dill, and optional paprika or rosemary.
Once the onion and garlic mixture is done, let it cool slightly before adding it to the mayonnaise mixture.
Stir in the chopped pickles and optional banana peppers until well combined.
Adjust seasoning to taste and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes before serving.
recipes.description: This classic chicken sandwich sauce combines the savory goodness of crispy sautéed red onions and garlic, harmoniously blended with creamy mayonnaise and tangy pickle juice. Optional red bell peppers add a sweet crunch, enhancing the flavor profile. Elevate your chicken sandwiches to gourmet status with this zesty sauce that brings a burst of flavor to every bite!

recipes.title: Crazy Coleslaws
directions: In a large bowl, combine the green cabbage, red cabbage, and carrots.
In a separate bowl, mix the mayonnaise, sour cream, apple cider vinegar, honey, and Dijon mustard until well combined.

Divide the dressing into six small bowls, adding chipotle sauce to one, BBQ sauce to another, hot sauce to the third, blue cheese to the fourth, yogurt and lemon juice to the fifth, and cilantro to the last.
Toss each dressing with the coleslaw mix to create six different coleslaw varieties.
Taste each coleslaw and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper as needed.
Serve immediately or refrigerate for an hour to let the flavors meld together.
recipes.description: Experience a crunch-tastic combination with this vibrant Crazy Coleslaw featuring crisp green and red cabbage alongside sweet carrots. The dressing, made from creamy mayonnaise, tangy apple cider vinegar, and a hint of honey, perfectly balances with the smoky notes of chipotle and BBQ sauces. This coleslaw is a refreshing hit, ideal for barbecues or as a side that steals the show!

recipes.title: Bangin Broccoli Salad
directions: Chop the broccoli into bite-sized pieces and place in a large mixing bowl.
Add the shredded cheddar cheese, sunflower seeds, dried cranberries, dried cherries, crumbled bacon, and chopped pepperoni to the bowl with the broccoli.
In a separate bowl, mix together the heavy mayonnaise, apple cider vinegar, and black pepper until well combined.
Pour the dressing over the broccoli mixture and stir until everything is evenly coated.
Cover the salad and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Give it a good stir before serving and enjoy!
recipes.description: Savor the delightful crunch of Bangin Broccoli Salad, where fresh broccoli meets a medley of shredded cheddar, sweet cranberries, and savory bacon. The creaminess of heavy mayonnaise combined with apple cider vinegar gives this salad a tangy kick that’s utterly addictive. It’s perfect for potlucks or a hearty side, bringing together flavors and textures that will make your taste buds dance!

recipes.title: Timeless Tzatziki Sauce
directions: Start by peeling and grating the cucumbers. Place them in a clean kitchen towel and squeeze out as much moisture as possible.
In a large bowl, combine the Greek yogurt, grated cucumbers, dehydrated red and white onions, fresh dill, parsley, minced garlic, lemon juice, red wine vinegar, olive oil, and mayonnaise.
Mix everything together until well combined, then season with salt and coarse black pepper to taste.
If using, stir in the dehydrated red bell pepper and roasted garlic.
Cover the bowl and let the mixture chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve with pita chips, fresh veggies, or as a sauce for grilled meats.
recipes.description: Timeless Tzatziki Sauce is a refreshing Greek classic, starring grated cucumbers and rich Greek yogurt blended with fragrant dill and garlic. The zest of lemon juice and red wine vinegar brightens each bite, while olive oil adds a luxurious finish. This sauce is the ultimate companion for grilled meats or fresh veggies, transforming any dish into a Mediterranean delight!

recipes.title: Terrific Tomato Soup
directions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Spread the cherry tomatoes, vine tomatoes, and sun-dried tomatoes on a baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil, and roast for about 20 minutes until caramelized.
In a large pot, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the white onion, red onion, red bell pepper, and orange bell pepper. Sauté until the onions are translucent, about 5 minutes.

Add the roasted tomatoes to the pot along with the veggie stock, chicken stock, balsamic vinegar, thyme, rosemary, oregano, and tomato paste. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and let it simmer for 15 minutes.
Using an immersion blender, blend the soup until smooth. If you don’t have an immersion blender, carefully transfer the soup to a regular blender in batches.
Stir in the heavy cream, sugar, Worcestershire sauce, and season with salt to taste. Simmer for another 5 minutes.
For optional grilled cheese, spread mayo on the outside of the sourdough bread, fill with sharp cheddar and mozzarella, and grill until golden brown on both sides.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with goat cheese, green onions, and fresh basil. Enjoy with the grilled cheese on the side if desired.
recipes.description: Warm your soul with this Terrific Tomato Soup, where roasted cherry, vine, and sun-dried tomatoes create a rich, caramelized base. Infused with sautéed onions and red bell pepper, this soup bursts with flavor and comfort. It’s a cozy dish that pairs perfectly with crusty bread, making it a must-try for any tomato lover!

recipes.title: Blended Green Olives and Feta Sauce
directions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Cut the top off the garlic head, drizzle with a bit of olive oil, wrap in foil, and roast for 35-40 minutes until soft and golden. Let cool, then squeeze out the roasted cloves.
In a food processor or blender, combine the green olives, roasted garlic cloves, feta, Parmesan, Italian seasoning, and basil. Pulse until roughly chopped.
With the processor running, slowly drizzle in the olive oil until the mixture reaches your desired consistency — smooth or slightly chunky.
Transfer to a saucepan over medium-low heat. Stir in the butter, lemon juice, and red pepper flakes. Cook for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until heated through.
Taste and adjust seasoning — add more lemon juice for brightness or red pepper flakes for heat. Serve warm or at room temperature.
recipes.description: A bold, tangy sauce that combines briny green olives with creamy feta and roasted garlic. Perfect for tossing with pasta, spreading on grilled chicken, or using as a dip for crusty bread.

recipes.title: Baconase Burger Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yellow mustard or whole grain mustard
directions: Cook bacon until crispy, then finely chop. Sauté onions and garlic in a bit of bacon fat until soft and golden, about 5 minutes. Let cool.
In a medium bowl, combine mayo, mustard, ketchup, bbq sauce, lemon juice, pickle juice, and Worcestershire sauce. Mix well.
Stir in the cooled bacon, sautéed onions and garlic, chopped pickles, parsley, thyme, cayenne, and black pepper.
Add honey and mix until everything is well combined. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld together. Serve on burgers, fries, or anything that needs a flavor boost.
recipes.description: A smoky, tangy burger sauce that's got everything — crispy bacon, sautéed onions, pickles, and a perfect balance of sweet and heat. Slather this on any burger and watch it disappear.

recipes.title: Hot Honey Asian Crunch Ranch
ingredients: 1/2 cup corn kernels (fresh, frozen, or canned)
directions: If using fresh or frozen corn, sauté in a dry skillet over medium-high heat until lightly charred, about 3-4 minutes. Let cool. If using canned, drain well.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the ranch dressing, hot honey, and crispy chili oil until smooth and well combined.
Fold in the diced serrano peppers and cooled corn kernels.
Transfer to a serving bowl and top with crushed honey roasted peanuts just before serving.
Taste and adjust heat level by adding more hot honey or chili oil if desired. Serve immediately or refrigerate up to 3 days.
recipes.description: A bold, sweet-heat ranch dip loaded with crispy chili oil, fresh serrano peppers, sweet corn, and crunchy honey roasted peanuts. Perfect for drizzling over fried chicken, dipping veggies, or tossing with wings.

recipes.title: Chimichurri Ranch
directions: Finely chop the fresh dill, parsley, and cilantro. Mince the garlic and dice the red onion as small as possible.
In a medium bowl, combine the mayo (or Greek yogurt), sour cream, heavy cream, and ranch seasoning. Whisk until smooth.
Add all the fresh herbs, garlic, red onion, red wine vinegar, lemon juice, and olive oil. Stir well to combine.
Season with red pepper flakes and cracked black pepper. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld together before serving.
recipes.description: A bright, herby twist on classic ranch that combines cooling dill with punchy chimichurri flavors. Perfect for drizzling on tacos, dipping veggies, or slathering on grilled chicken.

recipes.title: Feta Ground Beef Pesto Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 lb hot Italian sausage, casings removed
1 cup chunks of salami or pepperoni, roughly chopped
1/4 cup sliced jalapeños or pepperoncini peppers
directions: Cook the rotini pasta according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside.

In a large skillet or Dutch oven, heat olive oil and butter over medium-high heat. Add ground beef and Italian sausage, breaking up with a wooden spoon, and cook until browned, about 8-10 minutes. Drain excess fat if needed.
Add onions, red peppers, and garlic to the meat. Cook until vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in salami, sun dried tomatoes, jalapeños, and red pepper flakes.
Add the cooked pasta and pesto to the skillet, tossing everything together until well combined. Stir in feta, mozzarella, and goat cheese, allowing the cheeses to melt slightly.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed. Serve hot, topped with crushed croutons for crunch.
recipes.description: A hearty, loaded pasta dish that brings together ground beef, spicy Italian sausage, and three kinds of cheese with plenty of pesto and garlic. This is comfort food that packs a flavorful punch with every bite.

recipes.title: Cold Lemon Pepper Chicken Tzatziki Rice
directions: Season chicken breasts with 2 tablespoons lemon pepper and bake at 375°F for 25-30 minutes until cooked through. Let cool, then dice into bite-sized pieces and refrigerate.
Cook rice in chicken broth according to package directions. Once cooked, stir in remaining 1 tablespoon lemon pepper, parsley, and lemon juice. Let cool completely and refrigerate.
Cook bacon until crispy, crumble and set aside. Toss cubed potatoes with olive oil, salt, and pepper, then roast at 425°F for 25-30 minutes until golden and crunchy. Let cool.
Prep all vegetables: dice white onion, red peppers, cucumbers, tomatoes; slice jalapeños; and chop romaine lettuce.
To assemble bowls, start with a base of lemon pepper rice, then layer with romaine lettuce and all the prepped vegetables and corn.
Top each bowl with diced lemon pepper chicken, crumbled bacon, roasted potatoes, cottage cheese, and feta cheese.
Drizzle generously with tzatziki sauce (about ½ cup per bowl), add a squeeze of lemon juice, and finish with crushed pita chips and black pepper to taste. Serve cold.
recipes.description: A loaded Mediterranean-inspired rice bowl with tangy lemon pepper chicken, crispy bacon, fresh vegetables, and plenty of cooling tzatziki sauce. This cold, refreshing dish is perfect for meal prep or a light summer dinner.

recipes.title: Cold Chicken Salad
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, cooked crispy and crumbled
2 cups kettle cooked potato chips, roughly crushed
directions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the shredded chicken, bacon, feta, diced apples, grapes, walnuts, almonds, red onion, and celery.
In a small bowl, whisk together the mayo, sour cream, and honey until smooth.
Pour the dressing over the chicken mixture and toss everything together until well coated.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors come together.
Right before serving, top with the crushed potato chips so they stay crunchy.
recipes.description: This loaded chicken salad has everything going on — crispy bacon, crunchy apples and nuts, sweet grapes, and tangy feta all tossed in a honey-kissed dressing. The crushed potato chips on top add an addictive crunch that makes this way more than your average chicken salad.

recipes.title: Cold Mexican Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups corn (fresh, frozen, or canned and drained)
1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained and rinsed
directions: In a large bowl, combine the shredded chicken, diced apples, corn, celery, red pepper, tomato, cilantro, black beans, and feta cheese.
In a small bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, sour cream, and chipotle sauce until smooth.
Pour the dressing over the chicken mixture and toss everything together until well coated.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors come together.
Just before serving, fold in the crushed tortilla chips so they stay crunchy, or sprinkle them on top of individual servings.
recipes.description: A fresh, crunchy salad loaded with tender chicken, crisp vegetables, and sweet apple chunks, all tossed in a creamy chipotle dressing. Perfect for potlucks or a light lunch that's got just enough kick to keep things interesting.

recipes.title: Philly Cheese Steak Crockpot Dip
ingredients: 1 lb shaved steak, chopped into bite-sized pieces
2 cans (10 oz each) Rotel tomatoes with green chiles
16 oz cream cheese, softened and cubed
directions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown the ground beef and shaved steak with the garlic and black pepper. Drain excess fat and transfer to a 6-quart crockpot.
Add the diced salami, crumbled bacon, all the peppers, onions, jalapeños, Rotel tomatoes, corn, beef stock, and Au Jus packets to the crockpot. Stir to combine.
Cover and cook on low for 4-5 hours, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender and flavors have melded.
Add the cream cheese, pepper jack, cheddar, and Velveeta to the crockpot. Stir until all cheeses are melted and fully incorporated, about 15-20 minutes.
Prepare stuffing mix according to package directions. Spread the prepared stuffing over the top of the dip in the crockpot.
Cover and cook on low for an additional 30 minutes until the stuffing is heated through and slightly crispy on top. Serve hot with tortilla chips, bread, or crackers.
recipes.description: This loaded crockpot dip brings all the flavors of a Philly cheese steak to your party table, with layers of seasoned meats, colorful peppers, and a rich, melty cheese blend. Perfect for game day with tortilla chips or crusty bread.

recipes.title: Salmon Feta Tomato Spinach Crockpot Pasta
ingredients: 12 oz smoked salmon, flaked into chunks
directions: Add olive oil, butter, cherry tomatoes, garlic cloves, red peppers, jalapeños, Italian seasoning, black pepper, and honey to the crockpot. Stir to combine.
Cover and cook on low for 3-4 hours or high for 2 hours, until tomatoes are bursting and garlic is soft.
Mash some of the tomatoes and garlic with the back of a spoon to create a chunky sauce. Add the dry pasta and water or broth, stirring to submerge the pasta.
Cover and cook on high for 30-45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until pasta is tender.
Stir in the spinach and let it wilt for 5 minutes, then gently fold in the smoked salmon, feta, pickled red onions, and fresh basil.
Let stand for 5 minutes before serving. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper if needed.
recipes.description: This crockpot pasta brings together flaky smoked salmon, tangy feta, and burst cherry tomatoes in a rich, Mediterranean-inspired sauce that practically cooks itself. The pickled onions and jalapeños add just the right kick to balance all that creamy goodness.

recipes.title: Creamy Beef Horseradish Pot Roast
ingredients: 3 lbs chuck steak, cut into 2-inch chunks
2 red bell peppers, seeded and cut into chunks
4 large carrots, peeled and cut into 2-inch pieces
directions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, cook the chopped bacon until crispy. Remove bacon and set aside, leaving the drippings in the pan. Season chuck steak chunks generously with salt and half the black pepper, then brown them in the bacon fat in batches. Transfer browned beef to a slow cooker.

Add the red onion, garlic, red peppers, celery, carrots, and potatoes to the slow cooker with the beef. Tuck in the rosemary and thyme sprigs. Whisk together the beef stock and au jus packets, then pour over everything. Scatter the cooked bacon on top.
Cover and cook on low for 7-8 hours or high for 4-5 hours, until the beef is fork-tender and the vegetables are cooked through.

About 30 minutes before serving, remove about 1 cup of the cooking liquid and whisk it together with the cream cheese, sour cream, horseradish, and remaining black pepper in a bowl until smooth. Stir this mixture back into the slow cooker and let it heat through. Taste and adjust seasoning, adding more horseradish or pepper if you want more kick.
recipes.description: This hearty pot roast takes comfort food up a notch with a tangy, creamy horseradish sauce that cuts right through the rich beef and vegetables. Perfect for a Sunday dinner when you want something that practically cooks itself.

recipes.title: Pork and Chicken Hummus Crockpot
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder, chopped into 1-inch pieces
1 cup kalamata olives, pitted and halved
directions: Season the pork shoulder with 2 tablespoons shawarma spice and place in the bottom of a 6-quart crockpot. Season the shredded chicken with remaining 1 tablespoon shawarma spice and layer on top of the pork.

Spread the hummus over the meat, drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, then squeeze the roasted garlic cloves over everything. Cover and cook on low for 6-7 hours or high for 3-4 hours until pork is tender.
About 45 minutes before serving, toss the baby potatoes with olive oil, salt, and pepper, and roast at 425°F until golden and crispy.

When ready to serve, give the crockpot a gentle stir to mix the hummus with the meat juices. Top with pickled red onions, kalamata olives, fresh red onions, cucumbers, red peppers, tomatoes, and parsley.

Sprinkle feta cheese and crushed pita chips over the top. Serve family-style over the roasted potatoes with tzatziki sauce drizzled generously over everything. Top individual portions with a fried egg if desired.
recipes.description: A Mediterranean-inspired crockpot feast loaded with shawarma-spiced pork and chicken nestled in creamy hummus, then piled high with fresh veggies, feta, and crispy pita chips. Drizzle it all with tangy tzatziki and serve over roasted potatoes for a dinner that'll make everyone fight over seconds.

recipes.title: Spicy Peanut Pork on Glass Noodles
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
1 lb hot sausage, sliced into rounds
1 cup honey roasted peanuts, roughly chopped
2 red bell peppers, cut into strips
2 green bell peppers, cut into strips
Glass noodles or ginger rice for serving
directions: In a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat, brown the pork shoulder cubes and hot sausage slices until cooked through, about 8-10 minutes. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add sesame oil and sauté the onions, bell peppers, garlic, ginger, and Thai chilis until softened, about 5-6 minutes. Add the corn and cook 2 minutes more.
In a bowl, whisk together peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, sriracha, chili garlic paste, and black pepper until smooth. Add a splash of water if needed to thin the sauce.
Return the pork and sausage to the pan, then pour in the peanut sauce and toss to coat everything. Add the diced apples and cook for 3-4 minutes until apples soften slightly.
Stir in the crispy chili oil and half the peanuts. If using cream cheese, add it now and stir until melted and incorporated into the sauce.
Serve over prepared glass noodles or ginger rice, topped with remaining peanuts and sesame seeds.
recipes.description: A bold, sweet-and-spicy pork dish loaded with peppers, apples, and crunchy peanuts, all tossed in a rich peanut-sesame sauce. Serve it over glass noodles or ginger rice for a satisfying meal with serious heat.

recipes.title: BBQ Sweet Potato Beef and Pork Shoulder
ingredients: 2 large sweet potatoes, peeled and diced (about 4 cups)
directions: In a large Dutch oven or heavy pot over medium-high heat, cook the chopped bacon until crispy, about 5-6 minutes. Remove bacon and set aside, leaving the drippings in the pot.

Add ground beef to the pot and cook until browned, breaking it up as it cooks, about 6-8 minutes. Season with black pepper. Add the onions, red peppers, jalapeños, and garlic, cooking until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the diced sweet potatoes, corn, chopped pork shoulder, and cooked bacon. Add the butter and stir until melted.
Pour in the BBQ sauce, hot honey, and baked beans. Stir everything together and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and cook for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sweet potatoes are fork-tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning with more hot honey for sweetness, BBQ sauce for tang, or black pepper for heat. Serve hot.
recipes.description: A hearty, smoky one-pot meal that combines seasoned ground beef and pulled pork shoulder with sweet potatoes, bacon, and peppers, all brought together with tangy BBQ sauce and a kick of hot honey. Perfect for feeding a crowd or meal prepping for the week.

recipes.title: Creamy Steak and Sauerkraut Hot Sauce Pasta
ingredients: 8 oz cream cheese or cottage cheese
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain and set aside.
In a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat, brown the steak cubes, ground beef, and sliced bratwurst. Drain excess fat if needed.
Add onion, garlic, jalapeños, red pepper, and cook until vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in tomatoes, corn, sauerkraut, and green chiles.
Reduce heat to medium-low. Add sour cream, cream cheese, thyme, rosemary, Worcestershire sauce, horseradish, and Frank's RedHot. Stir until cheese melts and sauce is creamy.
Fold in cooked pasta and heat through for 2-3 minutes. Top with sliced green onions and serve hot.
recipes.description: A hearty, tangy pasta that brings together meats, sauerkraut, and a kick of hot sauce in a creamy sauce. This is comfort food with attitude — perfect for when you want something filling and bold.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Bacon Ranch Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb hot Italian sausage, casings removed
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain and set aside. Meanwhile, cook chopped bacon in a large skillet until crispy, remove and set aside, leaving drippings in pan.
In the same skillet, brown the hot sausage over medium-high heat, breaking it into crumbles. Add red onion, red peppers, carrots, and celery, cooking until vegetables are tender, about 8 minutes.
Stir in diced tomatoes, jalapeños, tomato purée, and Frank's RedHot. Add cream cheese in chunks, stirring until melted and combined with the sauce.
Add shredded chicken and cooked bacon to the skillet, then fold in the cooked pasta. Stir in ranch dressing and half the cheddar cheese until everything is well coated.
Top with remaining cheddar cheese and blue cheese crumbles. Cover and let sit for 2-3 minutes until cheese melts, or transfer to a baking dish and broil for 3-4 minutes until bubbly and golden.
recipes.description: This loaded pasta brings together everything you love about buffalo chicken wings with the comfort of a creamy, hearty pasta dish. Packed with spicy sausage, crispy bacon, and plenty of vegetables, it's a crowd-pleaser that hits all the right notes.

recipes.title: Chicken Bacon Ranch Chipotle Rice And Potatoes
ingredients: 1/2 cup chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, chopped
directions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss quartered potatoes with olive oil, chili lime seasoning, and a pinch of salt. Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 25-30 minutes until crispy and golden.
While potatoes roast, cook bacon until crispy, then crumble and set aside. In the same pan, sauté diced red onion and red bell pepper until softened, about 5 minutes.

In a large bowl, combine shredded chicken with fajita seasoning, adobo seasoning, ranch seasoning, and chopped chipotle peppers in adobo sauce. Mix in the sautéed peppers and onions, green chilies, and half the crumbled bacon.
Warm the Spanish rice and season with a squeeze of lime if needed. Set up your bowls with a base of Spanish rice, then add the roasted potatoes and chipotle chicken mixture.

Top each bowl generously with Mexican cheese, feta cheese, a dollop of cottage cheese, and drizzle with homemade ranch. Add diced tomatoes, pickled jalapeños, pickled red onions, remaining bacon, and fresh cilantro.
Serve with lime wedges and Chalula hot sauce on the side for everyone to customize their heat level.
recipes.description: A loaded Tex-Mex bowl that's got everything going on — smoky chipotle chicken, crispy bacon, roasted potatoes, and Spanish rice all topped with ranch, cheese, and plenty of pickled heat. This is the kind of dinner that makes everyone come back for seconds.

recipes.title: Dill Chicken Bacon Ranch Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb bacon, cooked crispy and chopped
directions: Cook the rigatoni according to package directions, drain, and set aside.
In a large skillet or pot over medium heat, combine the softened cream cheese and ranch dressing, stirring until smooth and creamy.
Add the shredded chicken, cooked bacon, red onion, pickles, tomatoes, and jalapeños to the cream cheese mixture. Stir well and cook for 3-4 minutes until heated through.
Toss in the cooked pasta and cheddar cheese, stirring until the cheese melts and everything is well combined.
Remove from heat and top each serving with fresh shredded iceberg lettuce before serving.
recipes.description: A loaded pasta dish that tastes like a bacon ranch salad met creamy comfort food — packed with crispy bacon, tangy pickles, and a kick of jalapeños that'll make you forget this is supposed to be healthy.

recipes.title: Meat Lovers Pizza Pasta Crockpot
ingredients: 24 oz vodka sauce or marinara sauce
Hot sauce or hot honey to taste (optional)
directions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown the ground beef and hot sausage together, breaking up the meat as it cooks. Drain excess fat and transfer to crockpot.

In the same skillet, cook the chopped bacon until crispy. Add the red onion, red pepper, garlic, jalapeños, and pepperoncini. Sauté for 3-4 minutes until vegetables soften, then transfer everything to the crockpot.

Add the ham, pepperoni, Italian seasoning, basil, vodka sauce, cream cheese (cut into chunks), and ranch packet if using to the crockpot. Stir to combine. Cover and cook on low for 4-5 hours or high for 2-3 hours.
About 30 minutes before serving, cook the rigatoni according to package directions until al dente. Drain and add to the crockpot along with cottage cheese if using.
Stir in the mozzarella and Parmesan cheese until melted and creamy. Let sit for 10 minutes to thicken. Adjust seasoning with hot sauce or drizzle with hot honey if desired, and serve hot.
recipes.description: This hearty crockpot pasta is loaded with every meat you could want — bacon, sausage, pepperoni, ham, and beef — all swimming in a creamy, cheesy sauce with a kick. It's like your favorite meat lovers pizza decided to become comfort food.

recipes.title: Italian Creamy Chicken Pasta Kinda Soup
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breasts, diced
1 cup orzo pasta (or 2 cups diced potatoes)
1/2 cup pepperoncini peppers, sliced (or cherry peppers)
1 cup grated Parmesan cheese, plus more for serving
directions: In a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat, brown the Italian sausage, breaking it up with a spoon. Add the diced chicken and cook until no longer pink, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the pepperoni, salami, red onion, red peppers, and garlic to the pot. Cook until vegetables soften, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, tomato puree, chicken stock, chicken bouillon, and Italian seasoning. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the orzo pasta (or potatoes if using) and cook until tender, about 8-10 minutes for orzo or 15 minutes for potatoes.
Stir in the spinach, pepperoncini peppers, parsley, and basil. Cook until spinach wilts, about 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and stir in the heavy cream and Parmesan cheese. Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until heated through and creamy.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper as needed. Serve hot with extra Parmesan cheese on top.
recipes.description: This hearty Italian-inspired soup is loaded with meats, vegetables, and pasta in a creamy tomato broth that'll warm you up from the inside out. It's like your favorite Italian sub sandwich decided to become a comforting bowl of soup.

recipes.title: BBQ Ground Beef and Potato Crockpot
ingredients: 1 cup frozen or canned corn, drained
1½ lbs small red or yellow potatoes, roasted
2 cups shredded cheddar or pepper jack cheese
directions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown the ground beef with the chopped bacon until the beef is cooked through and bacon is crispy, about 8-10 minutes. Drain excess fat.
Transfer the beef and bacon to your crockpot. Add the diced onion, red peppers, garlic, corn, tomatoes, BBQ sauce, thyme, and rosemary. Stir everything together and season with salt and pepper.
Cover and cook on low for 6-7 hours or high for 3-4 hours, stirring occasionally if possible.
While the crockpot is cooking, roast the small potatoes: toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper, then roast at 400°F for 25-30 minutes until tender and golden.
About 30 minutes before serving, add the roasted potatoes to the crockpot and gently stir them in.
Top with shredded cheese, cover, and let it melt for 5-10 minutes before serving.
recipes.description: A hearty crockpot meal that's like a loaded BBQ baked potato meets a cowboy casserole. Smoky, cheesy, and packed with flavor — perfect for a busy weeknight when you want comfort food waiting for you.

recipes.title: Baked Beans and Sausage Crockpot
ingredients: 1 whole head garlic, cloves peeled and smashed
directions: In a large skillet over medium heat, cook the chopped bacon until crispy, then remove and set aside, leaving drippings in the pan.
In the same skillet, brown the sliced bratwurst for 3-4 minutes, then transfer to the crockpot along with the Lil Smokies.
Add the baked beans, diced potatoes, onions, red peppers, jalapeños, garlic cloves, and cooked bacon to the crockpot.
Stir in the tomato paste, thyme, Worcestershire sauce, chicken stock, BBQ sauce, and black pepper until everything is well combined.
Cover and cook on low for 6-7 hours or high for 3-4 hours, until potatoes are tender and flavors have melded together.
About 15 minutes before serving, stir in the fresh parsley and adjust seasoning with additional salt, pepper, or BBQ sauce to taste.
recipes.description: A hearty, smoky crockpot meal packed with beans, sausages, and bacon that's perfect for feeding a crowd or meal prepping for the week. Everything slow-cooks together into a rich, savory comfort dish that's basically a Southern BBQ party in a pot.

recipes.title: Cajun Chicken, Shrimp and Sausage Crockpot
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts, shredded
1 lb andouille or smoked sausage, sliced into rounds
1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
1 cup shredded cheddar cheese or grated Parmesan
directions: Add shredded chicken, sliced sausage, onions, garlic, corn, red peppers, and diced tomatoes to the crockpot.
Stir in the uncooked Spanish rice, chicken stock, bouillon, and Cajun seasoning until well combined.
Cover and cook on low for 5-6 hours or high for 3-4 hours, until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
About 20 minutes before serving, stir in the shrimp and heavy cream. Cover and cook until shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Turn off heat, stir in cheese until melted, adjust seasoning with more Cajun spice if needed, and serve hot.
recipes.description: A hearty, spice-filled crockpot meal that brings together tender chicken, smoky sausage, and plump shrimp in a creamy Cajun-seasoned rice. Perfect for feeding a crowd without much fuss.

recipes.title: Lil Smokies Cheese Stew Crockpot
ingredients: 1½ lbs russet potatoes, diced into ½-inch cubes
3 large carrots, peeled and sliced into ½-inch rounds
1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, chopped (or 1 teaspoon dried)
directions: Add potatoes, carrots, onions, garlic, jalapeños, and corn to a 6-quart crockpot.
Place Lil Smokies on top of the vegetables, then sprinkle with thyme, rosemary, and black pepper.
Pour beef stock over everything and stir in beef bouillon.
Cover and cook on low for 6-7 hours or high for 3-4 hours, until potatoes and carrots are tender.
About 30 minutes before serving, stir in cream cheese cubes until melted.
Add Parmesan and cheddar cheese, stirring until fully melted and creamy.
Taste and adjust seasoning with additional black pepper or salt if needed, then serve hot.
recipes.description: A hearty, cheesy crockpot stew loaded with smoky little sausages, tender vegetables, and three kinds of cheese. Perfect for a cold day when you want something rich and comforting without much fuss.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff Crockpot
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck steak, cut into 1-inch cubes, or 2 lbs ground beef
directions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown the chuck steak (or ground beef) and Jimmy Dean's sausage together, breaking up the sausage as it cooks. Drain excess fat and transfer meat to crockpot.
Add butter, onion, red peppers, garlic, jalapeños, corn, carrots, beef broth, stroganoff seasoning packets, black pepper, thyme, and rosemary to the crockpot. Stir to combine with the meat.
Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours or high for 3-4 hours, until beef is tender and vegetables are cooked through.
About 30 minutes before serving, cook egg noodles according to package directions and drain. Cut cream cheese into cubes and add to crockpot along with heavy cream and optional tomatoes if using.
Stir until cream cheese is fully melted and sauce is smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Serve stroganoff over egg noodles or stir noodles directly into the crockpot before serving.
recipes.description: This hearty crockpot stroganoff is loaded with tender beef, spicy sausage, and plenty of vegetables in a rich, creamy sauce that'll warm you right up. Perfect for a busy weeknight when you want comfort food waiting for you at home.

recipes.title: Frito Pie Crockpot Dip
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained and rinsed
1 lb carne asada, cooked and chopped
directions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown the ground beef with minced garlic until fully cooked; drain excess fat and transfer to a 6-quart crockpot.
Add the shredded chicken, carne asada, bacon, black beans, refried beans, Spanish rice, corn, green chilies, red onion, pickled jalapeños, and cilantro to the crockpot.
Stir in the sour cream, cream cheese, 2 cups of the cheddar cheese, salsa, chipotle sauce, Cholula, Taco Bell sauce, and lime juice until well combined.
Cover and cook on low for 3-4 hours or high for 2 hours, stirring occasionally, until hot and bubbly throughout.
About 15 minutes before serving, top with the remaining 1 cup cheddar cheese, cover, and let melt.
Serve the dip in a large bowl surrounded by shredded iceberg lettuce, drizzled with southwestern dressing, with plenty of Fritos for dipping.
recipes.description: This loaded crockpot dip is everything you love about Frito pie turned into the ultimate party dip — packed with seasoned meats, beans, cheese, and all the fixings, served in a bowl with crispy lettuce and plenty of Fritos for scooping.

recipes.title: Dorthy Lynch Lil Smokey’s
ingredients: 1 lb bacon, strips cut in half
8 oz pepper jack cheese, cut into small cubes
directions: Preheat oven to 375°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper or foil.
In a bowl, mix together the softened cream cheese and diced jalapeños until well combined.
Slice each lil smokie lengthwise (not all the way through) and stuff with a small dollop of the jalapeño cream cheese mixture and a cube of pepper jack cheese.
Wrap each stuffed smokie with half a strip of bacon and secure with a toothpick.
Arrange wrapped smokies on the prepared baking sheet and brush generously with Dorothy Lynch dressing.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until bacon is crispy, brushing with more Dorothy Lynch halfway through.
Let cool for 5 minutes before serving with extra Dorothy Lynch dressing for dipping.
recipes.description: Bacon-wrapped lil smokies stuffed with cream cheese, pepper jack, and jalapeños, then glazed with tangy Dorothy Lynch dressing. These crowd-pleasing bites are smoky, creamy, spicy, and downright addictive.

recipes.title: Dorothy Lynch Crockpot Dip
ingredients: 2 cups smoked and shredded pork shoulder
8 oz cream cheese, softened and cubed
directions: Add the shredded chicken and pork shoulder to a 6-quart slow cooker.
Pour in the Dorothy Lynch dressing and beef broth, then add the cream cheese cubes and half of the cheddar cheese. Stir to combine.
Add the red onion, red pepper, celery, corn, carrots, and jalapeños. Season with black pepper and stir everything together.
Cover and cook on low for 3-4 hours, stirring occasionally to help the cream cheese melt and incorporate.
About 30 minutes before serving, stir in the diced apples and remaining cheddar cheese.
Continue cooking until the cheese is fully melted and the dip is hot throughout. Adjust seasoning with additional black pepper if needed.
Serve warm with tortilla chips, crackers, or toasted baguette slices.
recipes.description: A hearty slow cooker dip loaded with smoky meats, crisp vegetables, and sweet apple chunks, all brought together with tangy Dorothy Lynch dressing and melty cheese. Perfect for game day or any gathering where you need a crowd-pleasing appetizer.

recipes.title: Yellow Potato Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs Yukon Gold potatoes, cut into 3/4-inch cubes
4 oz cream cheese or goat cheese, softened
Salt and black pepper to taste
2 cups crushed Cool Ranch Doritos (for topping)
directions: Boil the cubed potatoes in chicken stock until fork-tender, about 12-15 minutes. Drain and let cool completely. Meanwhile, cook bacon until crispy, then crumble.
