Peel the hard boiled eggs and separate the yolks from the whites. Chop the egg whites and set aside. Mash the yolks in a large bowl.

Add mayonnaise, sour cream, cream cheese, both mustards, honey mustard vinaigrette, paprika, red pepper flakes, garlic powder, thyme, and dill to the mashed yolks. Mix until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the cooled potatoes, chopped egg whites, bacon, cheddar cheese, relish, red onion, celery, bell pepper, cucumber, and chives to the bowl. Gently fold everything together until well coated.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to let flavors meld. Just before serving, top with crushed Cool Ranch Doritos.
recipes.description: A loaded Southern-style potato salad that's rich, tangy, and packed with bacon, cheese, and fresh veggies. The secret is boiling the potatoes in chicken stock and finishing with crushed Cool Ranch Doritos for an unexpected crunch.

recipes.title: Italian Pasta Salad
directions: Cook the rigatoni according to package directions until al dente. Drain, rinse with cold water, and transfer to a large mixing bowl.
Add the pepperoni, salami, chicken, mozzarella, crushed croutons, feta, red onion, pepperoncini, bell pepper, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, celery, arugula, basil, and olives if using to the pasta.

In a small bowl, mash the roasted garlic cloves and whisk together with the mayo or Greek yogurt, Italian dressing, lemon juice, Italian seasoning, thyme, parsley, black pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Pour the dressing over the pasta salad and toss everything together until well combined. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving to let the flavors meld together.
recipes.description: A loaded Italian pasta salad packed with meats, cheeses, and fresh vegetables, all tossed in a zesty Italian dressing. Perfect for potlucks, picnics, or a hearty side dish that eats like a meal.

recipes.title: Pork Belly Chicharron with Guacamole
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili lime seasoning or carne asada seasoning
directions: Coat pork belly generously with buffalo sauce and BBQ rub. Slice into 4-inch sections, then cut slits halfway through the belly every inch (like an accordion). Smoke at 225°F for 2 hours until tender.

While pork is smoking, make the guacamole: mash avocados in a bowl, then mix in diced tomato, red onion, cilantro, garlic salt, black pepper, lime juice, and lemon juice. Adjust seasoning to taste and refrigerate until ready to serve.

After smoking, heat lard in a large, deep skillet or Dutch oven to 375°F. Carefully add pork belly sections and fry for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until deeply golden and crispy on all sides.
Remove chicharrones from lard and drain briefly on paper towels. While still hot, sprinkle generously with chili lime or carne asada seasoning. Serve immediately with the fresh guacamole for dipping.
recipes.description: Crispy, smoky pork belly chicharrones with a spicy kick, served alongside fresh, zesty guacamole. This indulgent dish combines the crunch of twice-cooked pork with cool, creamy avocado for the perfect flavor contrast.

recipes.title: Tuna Salad (no pasta)
ingredients: 6 strips bacon, cooked crispy and crumbled
1 cup white corn (canned or frozen, thawed)
directions: Cook bacon until crispy, then crumble and set aside. Prep all vegetables by dicing them into small, uniform pieces.
In a large mixing bowl, combine tuna, bacon, cheddar cheese, pickles, red onion, bell peppers, cucumber, jalapeños, celery, peas, and corn.
In a separate small bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, black pepper, red pepper flakes, thyme, and optional mustard and wasabi if using.
Pour dressing over tuna mixture and gently fold everything together until well combined.
Fold in feta cheese, then top with crushed jalapeño chips right before serving. Serve chilled or at room temperature.
recipes.description: A loaded, protein-packed tuna salad with bacon, crunchy veggies, and a creamy, tangy dressing — plus crushed jalapeño chips for that perfect salty crunch. This ain't your mama's boring tuna salad.

recipes.title: Tuna Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 cup white corn (canned or frozen, thawed)
directions: Cook penne pasta according to package directions until al dente. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool completely.
In a large bowl, combine the cooled pasta, tuna, cheddar cheese, red onion, cherry tomatoes, bell pepper, cucumber, peas, and corn.
In a small bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, lemon juice, olive oil, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. If using wasabi, add ¼-½ teaspoon to the dressing and mix well.
Pour dressing over pasta mixture and toss until everything is well coated. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to let flavors blend.
Just before serving, top with crumbled feta cheese and crushed kettle chips for crunch.
recipes.description: A colorful, hearty pasta salad loaded with chunky tuna, crisp veggies, and a creamy lemon-mayo dressing. The crushed kettle chips on top add an unexpected crunch that takes this potluck favorite to the next level.

recipes.title: Everything Egg Salad
ingredients: 8 strips bacon, cooked crispy and crumbled
1/2 cup red bell pepper, finely diced
2 tablespoons yellow mustard or whole grain mustard
Optional: 1 cup corn kernels (fresh or canned, drained)
directions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the chopped hard boiled eggs, bacon, pickles, celery, red onion, jalapeños, cucumber, red peppers, and cherry tomatoes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the mayo, mustard, sour cream, lemon juice, red pepper flakes, and black pepper until smooth.
Pour the dressing over the egg mixture and gently fold everything together until well combined.
Add the goat cheese, fresh dill, parsley, thyme, and everything bagel seasoning. Gently fold again, being careful not to mash the eggs too much.
If using optional ingredients (corn, croutons, or hashbrowns), fold them in now.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors come together. Taste and adjust seasoning with more everything bagel seasoning, salt, or pepper if needed.
Serve cold on its own, over greens, or piled on toasted bread or bagels.
recipes.description: This isn't your mama's egg salad — it's loaded with everything but the kitchen sink. Crunchy veggies, crispy bacon, fresh herbs, and tangy goat cheese make this a hearty salad that can stand on its own or pile high on a sandwich.

recipes.title: White Potato Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs red potatoes, cut into bite-sized chunks
½ cup diced red bell peppers
4 oz cream cheese or goat cheese, softened
Salt and black pepper to taste
directions: Boil the potatoes in chicken stock until fork-tender, about 15-20 minutes. Drain and let cool completely in the refrigerator.
While potatoes cool, cook bacon until crispy, then crumble. Dice all the vegetables and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, sour cream, cream cheese, lemon juice, vinegar, and honey until smooth. Stir in red pepper flakes, paprika, dill, thyme, and garlic powder.
Add the cooled potatoes, crumbled bacon, shredded cheddar, red onions, celery, bell peppers, and cucumber to the dressing. Fold everything together gently.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Fold in the fresh chives.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving to let the flavors come together.
recipes.description: A loaded potato salad packed with crispy bacon, sharp white cheddar, and plenty of fresh veggies, all tossed in a creamy, tangy dressing. This ain't your grandma's potato salad — it's got more flavor and crunch in every bite.

recipes.title: Tri Tip Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 1½ lbs smoked tri-tip steak, sliced thin (rubbed with 2 tbsp black pepper and 1 tbsp sugar before smoking)
½ cup crumbled feta cheese or shaved parmesan
directions: Cook bacon until crispy, then drain on paper towels and set aside. In the same pan, sauté onions, garlic, and red peppers in bacon fat over medium heat until softened and caramelized, about 8-10 minutes.
Prepare garlic parmesan fries according to package directions, then toss hot fries with olive oil, garlic powder, and grated parmesan while still hot.
Mix softened goat cheese with chimichurri sauce and spread generously on the bottom half of each toasted ciabatta roll.
Layer each sandwich: start with sliced tri-tip, then sautéed vegetables, bacon, candied jalapeños, pickled red onions, feta or parmesan, and fresh arugula on top.
Drizzle peppercorn sauce generously over the entire sandwich, place the top bun on, and serve with crispy garlic fries and extra peppercorn sauce on the side for dipping.
recipes.description: A loaded tri-tip sandwich piled high with smoky peppered meat, crispy bacon, sautéed vegetables, and tangy condiments, all served on toasted ciabatta with crispy garlic fries on the side. Every bite gets drizzled with rich peppercorn sauce and comes with extra for dipping.

recipes.title: Colorful Rice for Curry
ingredients: Water for cooking (as needed per rice package directions)
directions: Cook each colored rice variety separately according to package directions, adding a pinch of salt to each pot.
While rice is cooking, prepare serving platter or individual plates.
Once all rice varieties are cooked and fluffy, let them cool slightly for easier handling.
Arrange the different colored rices side by side on a large serving platter in rainbow order, or layer them in sections for a dramatic presentation.
Serve warm alongside your favorite curry, allowing guests to scoop a colorful mix of rice onto their plates.
recipes.description: A stunning rainbow of naturally colored rice varieties that makes the perfect colorful bed for any curry. Each grain brings its own subtle flavor and creates a beautiful presentation that'll have everyone reaching for seconds.

recipes.title: Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Soup
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
Salt and black pepper to taste
directions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Season chicken with salt and pepper, then cook until golden brown, about 5-6 minutes. Remove chicken and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté garlic, Italian seasoning, and red pepper flakes for about 1 minute until fragrant. Add sun-dried tomatoes and stir.
Pour in chicken broth and heavy cream, then bring to a simmer. Add gnocchi and cook according to package directions, usually 3-4 minutes until they float.
Return chicken to the pot along with spinach. Stir until spinach wilts, about 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in Parmesan cheese. Taste and adjust seasoning with additional salt and pepper if needed. Garnish with fresh basil before serving.
recipes.description: A creamy, indulgent soup with tender gnocchi, sun-dried tomatoes, and Italian herbs that'll have everyone asking for seconds. Rich enough to make any weeknight feel special.

recipes.title: Raisin Cane’s Copy Cat Sauce
directions: In a medium bowl, combine mayonnaise and ketchup until well blended.
Add garlic powder, Worcestershire sauce, black pepper, and paprika if using.
Whisk everything together until smooth and well combined.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld together before serving.
recipes.description: That tangy, slightly sweet sauce that makes Raising Cane's chicken fingers so addictive. Perfect for dipping chicken tenders, fries, or just about anything that needs a flavor boost.

recipes.title: Crispy Chili Sweet and Sour Pork Shoulder Crockpot
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 2-inch chunks
1 lb smoked sausage, sliced into 1-inch pieces
Cooked rice or glass noodles, for serving
directions: Add pork shoulder, sausage, yellow onion, red onion, and smashed garlic to the crockpot.

Pour in sweet and sour sauce, crispy chili oil, and pineapple juice. Add pineapple chunks, apples, all three bell peppers, cabbage, sauerkraut, jalapeños, and Szechuan chilies. Season with black pepper and stir to combine.
Cover and cook on low for 7-8 hours or high for 4-5 hours, until pork is tender and shreds easily with a fork.
About 30 minutes before serving, shred the pork chunks with two forks right in the crockpot and stir everything together. Taste and adjust seasoning with more chili oil or black pepper if desired.
Serve over rice or glass noodles, topped with honey roasted peanuts and sesame seeds, with roasted potatoes on the side.
recipes.description: A bold, sweet-and-tangy slow cooker pork loaded with crispy chili oil, pineapple, peppers, and cabbage. Serve it over rice or glass noodles with roasted potatoes on the side for a hearty meal with serious flavor.

recipes.title: BBQ Candied Party Ribs
ingredients: 2 racks baby back ribs, cut into individual bones
directions: Prepare smoker to 225°F. Coat individual rib bones all over with yellow mustard and hot sauce, then generously season with BBQ rub.
Smoke ribs for 3 hours until meat is tender and pulling back from the bones.

Remove ribs from smoker and place in a large aluminum roasting pan. Pour 3/4 cup BBQ sauce over ribs, then sprinkle with 1/2 cup brown sugar. Add butter slices, jalapeños, and pineapple or apples around the ribs.
Drizzle remaining 3/4 cup BBQ sauce and remaining 1/2 cup brown sugar over everything. Cover pan tightly with foil and return to smoker for 2 hours.
Remove from smoker, uncover, and generously coat the top of the ribs with crushed jalapeño kettle chips. Serve immediately while chips are still crunchy.
recipes.description: These fall-off-the-bone baby back ribs get smoked low and slow, then finished in a sweet and spicy bath of BBQ sauce, brown sugar, and jalapeños before getting crowned with crunchy kettle chip coating. They're sticky, smoky, and absolutely addictive — perfect for a party.

recipes.title: Cajun Shrimp, Chicken and Bacon Scampi Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
2 chicken breasts (about 1 lb), cooked and shredded
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain and set aside. Season shrimp generously with 1 tablespoon Cajun seasoning and set aside.

In a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat, cook chopped bacon until crispy. Remove and set aside. Add diced pork belly to the same pan and cook until crispy and rendered, about 6-8 minutes. Remove and set aside with bacon.

In the same pan with the bacon fat, add olive oil and sauté onions and red peppers until softened, about 5 minutes. Add both minced and sliced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Push vegetables to the side and add seasoned shrimp, cooking 2-3 minutes per side until pink and cooked through.

Reduce heat to medium and add butter, letting it melt completely. Stir in heavy cream, remaining 2 tablespoons Cajun seasoning, Frank's RedHot, black pepper, and cayenne powder. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the cooked pasta, shredded chicken, crispy bacon, and pork belly to the sauce. Toss everything together and let simmer for 2-3 minutes to combine flavors.
Remove from heat and stir in Parmesan cheese until melted and creamy. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately with extra Parmesan on the side.
recipes.description: This loaded Cajun scampi pasta packs serious flavor with three proteins swimming in a buttery, garlicky cream sauce with just enough kick to keep things interesting. It's indulgent comfort food that'll make you forget about whatever diet you were planning to start tomorrow.

recipes.title: Creamy Crispy Chili Oil Chicken Bacon Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 cup crispy chili oil (plus more to taste)
1 cup honey roasted peanuts, roughly chopped
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet over medium heat, cook bacon until crispy, then remove and set aside. In the same pan, cook candied pork belly until crispy, remove and set aside.
In the bacon fat, add red onions and cook 15-20 minutes until deeply caramelized. Add garlic, bell peppers, and serrano peppers, cooking 5 minutes more. Stir in crispy chili oil and black pepper.
Reduce heat to medium-low and add tomato purée, sour cream, cream cheese, and heavy cream. Whisk until smooth and creamy, then fold in parmesan cheese until melted.
Add shredded chicken, cooked bacon, and candied pork belly to the sauce. Stir to combine and heat through.
Toss the cooked pasta into the sauce until well coated. Adjust seasoning with more chili oil if desired.
Serve topped with honey roasted peanuts, fresh parsley, and green onions.
recipes.description: A rich and indulgent pasta dish that brings serious heat with crispy chili oil, balanced by creamy cheese and sour cream, with candied pork belly and bacon adding sweet-savory depth. The honey roasted peanuts on top give it an unexpected crunch that'll keep you coming back for more.

recipes.title: Creamy Cajun Cabbage and Sausage Crockpot
directions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, cook the bacon until crispy, then remove and set aside. Brown the ground beef and sausage in the bacon fat, breaking up the beef as it cooks. Drain excess grease and transfer meat to the crockpot.

Add the cabbage, sauerkraut, onions, red peppers, garlic, carrots, corn, and jalapeños to the crockpot. Stir in the Cajun seasoning, red pepper flakes, black pepper, butter, and Frank's RedHot. Mix everything together well.
Cover and cook on low for 6-7 hours or high for 3-4 hours, until the cabbage and vegetables are tender.
About 15 minutes before serving, stir in the sour cream and pepper jack cheese until melted and creamy. Top with the reserved crispy bacon. Serve over roasted potatoes or Cajun rice.
recipes.description: This hearty crockpot dish loads up smoky meats with tender cabbage and tangy sauerkraut, all swimming in a creamy, spicy Cajun sauce. Serve it over roasted potatoes or Cajun rice for a comforting meal that'll warm you right up.

recipes.title: Eggs Benedict Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs Yukon gold potatoes, diced into 1/2-inch cubes
1 lb bacon, cooked crispy and crumbled
1 whole head garlic, cloves peeled and minced
4 cups sourdough bread, torn into chunks
Salt and black pepper to taste
directions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss diced potatoes with 2 tablespoons olive oil, salt, and pepper, spread on a baking sheet, and roast for 25-30 minutes until golden and crispy, stirring halfway through.

While potatoes roast, cook breakfast sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up as it cooks. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, cook bacon until crispy, then crumble. Set aside.
In remaining tablespoon of olive oil, sauté yellow onion, red peppers, and minced garlic until softened, about 5-6 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 375°F.

In a large bowl, whisk together eggs and sour cream until well combined. Stir in cooked sausage, ham, candied pork belly, half the bacon, roasted potatoes, sautéed vegetables, sourdough chunks, 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese, half the green onions, and red pepper flakes. Season with salt and pepper.
Pour mixture into a greased 9x13-inch baking dish. Top with remaining cheddar cheese and bacon.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until eggs are set and top is golden brown. Let rest 5 minutes.
Drizzle generously with hollandaise sauce and garnish with remaining green onions and fresh parsley before serving.
recipes.description: This loaded breakfast casserole takes everything you love about Eggs Benedict and turns it into a hearty, crowd-pleasing dish packed with crispy meats, roasted potatoes, and plenty of rich hollandaise sauce. Perfect for feeding a hungry crew on weekend mornings.

recipes.title: Cajun Tuscan Salmon Pasta
ingredients: 8 oz smoked salmon, flaked into pieces
1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
1 cup sun-dried tomatoes in oil, drained and chopped
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile, cook bacon in a large deep skillet over medium heat until crispy, then remove and set aside, leaving 2 tablespoons of bacon fat in the pan.
In the same skillet with bacon fat, sauté onions and bell peppers for 4-5 minutes until softened. Add garlic and jalapeños, cook 1 minute more until fragrant.

Add butter to the skillet and let melt. Stir in sun-dried tomatoes, cherry tomatoes, oregano, Cajun seasoning, and red pepper flakes. Cook for 2-3 minutes, then add shrimp and cook until pink and just cooked through, about 3-4 minutes.
Reduce heat to medium-low and add cream cheese, heavy cream, and Parmesan cheese, stirring until smooth and creamy. Add spinach and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.

Gently fold in the cooked pasta, flaked smoked salmon, crispy bacon, basil, and parsley. Drizzle with lemon juice and toss everything together until well coated. Taste and adjust seasoning with more Cajun spice or salt if needed. Serve immediately with extra Parmesan on top.
recipes.description: A bold, creamy pasta loaded with smoky salmon, plump shrimp, and crispy bacon in a rich Cajun-spiced Tuscan sauce. This one-pan wonder brings together sun-dried tomatoes, fresh veggies, and plenty of herbs for a restaurant-quality dinner that's ready in under an hour.

recipes.title: Spicy Pink Sauce Angel Hair Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb hot Italian sausage, casings removed
1 head roasted garlic, cloves squeezed out
Salt and black pepper to taste
directions: Cook angel hair pasta according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet over medium-high heat, cook bacon until crispy. Remove and set aside. In the same pan, brown the Italian sausage, breaking it into crumbles. Set aside with bacon.

Heat olive oil and butter in the skillet over medium heat. Sauté shallots, minced garlic, and serrano peppers for 3-4 minutes until softened. Add red peppers and red onion, cooking until tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato purée, roasted garlic cloves, Italian seasoning, and red pepper flakes. Simmer for 5 minutes, then reduce heat to low and stir in heavy cream and ricotta cheese until smooth.
Add the cooked sausage, bacon, and shredded chicken to the sauce. Fold in spinach until just wilted, about 2 minutes.
Toss the cooked pasta with the sauce until well coated. Stir in half the Parmesan cheese and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
Serve topped with remaining Parmesan cheese and fresh parsley.
recipes.description: A rich and creamy pink sauce loaded with spicy Italian sausage, bacon, and tender chicken tossed with angel hair pasta. This indulgent dish gets its kick from serrano peppers and red pepper flakes, balanced by sweet roasted garlic and fresh spinach.

recipes.title: Roasted Peppers and Walnuts Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb hot Italian sausage, casings removed
2 cups roasted red peppers (jarred or fresh)
directions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Cut the top off the head of garlic, drizzle with olive oil, wrap in foil, and roast for 35-40 minutes until soft and golden. Let cool, then squeeze out the cloves.

Cook pasta according to package directions. While pasta cooks, brown the Italian sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up as it cooks. Add yellow onion and red bell pepper, cooking until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in shredded chicken, salami chunks, and Italian seasoning. Set aside.
In a blender or food processor, combine roasted garlic cloves, roasted red peppers, walnuts, feta cheese, tomato paste, Greek yogurt, and half the Parmesan. Blend until smooth and creamy.
Drain pasta and return to pot. Add butter and toss until melted. Pour in the roasted pepper sauce and stir to coat. Add the meat mixture and ricotta cheese, stirring gently to combine.
Transfer to a large serving bowl and top with remaining Parmesan, fresh basil, parsley, and diced red onion. Serve hot.
recipes.description: A hearty pasta loaded with meats and tossed in a creamy roasted red pepper and walnut sauce that's rich, savory, and packed with flavor. The blended sauce with roasted garlic and tangy feta makes this dish absolutely irresistible.

recipes.title: Alfs kitchen on YouTube for all things burger recipes
directions: Gently mix ground beef with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder in a large bowl. Don't overwork the meat.
Divide meat into 6 equal portions and form into patties about 3/4-inch thick. Make a small indent in the center of each patty with your thumb to prevent bulging.
Heat grill or cast iron skillet over medium-high heat. Cook patties 4-5 minutes per side for medium doneness, flipping only once.
If using cheese, add slices during the last minute of cooking and cover to melt. Toast buns on the grill during this time.
Assemble burgers with desired toppings and serve immediately.
recipes.description: A classic, no-nonsense burger that lets quality beef shine through with just the right seasonings. Perfect for backyard grilling or a quick weeknight dinner.

recipes.title: Burger Sauces
ingredients: 1/2 cup crisp red apple, finely diced
directions: Roast the garlic: Wrap 6 cloves of garlic in foil with a drizzle of oil and roast at 400°F for 25-30 minutes until soft and golden. Mash into a paste.
Sauté the onions: In a skillet over medium heat, cook the diced yellow onions with a bit of butter until soft and caramelized, about 8-10 minutes. Let cool.

Make White Sauce: In a bowl, combine mayo, melted butter, whole grain mustard, chopped pickles, half the sautéed onions, Worcestershire, garlic powder, black pepper, paprika, and half the roasted garlic. Mix well and refrigerate.

Make Classic Burger Sauce: In another bowl, mix mayo, ketchup, yellow mustard, pickle juice, chopped pickles, half the remaining sautéed onions, Worcestershire, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and remaining roasted garlic. Stir until smooth and refrigerate.
Make Hot Honey Apple Mayo: In a third bowl, combine mayo, sriracha, hot honey, remaining sautéed onions, diced apple, strawberry jam, honey, peanut butter, and black pepper. Mix until well blended.
Taste each sauce and adjust seasoning as needed — add more hot honey for sweetness, sriracha for heat, or pickle juice for tang.
Cover and refrigerate all sauces for at least 30 minutes to let flavors meld before serving.
These sauces will keep in the fridge for up to 5 days — just give them a good stir before using.
recipes.description: Three killer burger sauces that'll take your burgers from ordinary to legendary — a tangy white sauce, a classic burger sauce with all the fixings, and a sweet-heat apple mayo that's pure genius.

recipes.title: Burger Sauces
ingredients: 1/2 cup dill pickles, finely chopped (or 1/4 cup dill relish)
Red Sauce (optional): 2 tablespoons sweet relish instead of pickles
Red Sauce (optional): 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar
Yellow Sauce (optional): 2 tablespoons sweet relish instead of pickles
Yellow Sauce (optional): 1 teaspoon white or apple cider vinegar
Dark Red Sauce: 1/3 cup BBQ sauce
Dark Red Sauce: 3 tablespoons Dijon honey mustard
Dark Red Sauce: 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce
Dark Red Sauce: 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
Dark Red Sauce (optional): 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar
Dark Red Sauce (optional): 2 tablespoons sweet relish instead of pickles
Optional for any sauce: 1/2 red bell pepper or 1 poblano pepper, finely diced
directions: Heat bacon fat in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced sweet onion and minced garlic, sautéing until slightly crispy and golden brown, about 8-10 minutes. If using, add diced bell pepper or poblano pepper during the last 5 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool.
While onions cool, finely chop pickles into small chunks (or use dill relish if you're taking the easy route).
Divide the cooled onion mixture evenly among three bowls for your three sauces.

For Red Sauce: Mix ketchup, mayonnaise, yellow mustard, Worcestershire, paprika, salt, pepper, and pickles with one portion of the onion mixture. Add optional sweet relish or red wine vinegar if desired.
For Yellow Sauce: Combine yellow mustard, mayonnaise, salt, pepper, paprika, and pickles with the second portion of onion mixture. Stir in optional honey, sweet relish, or vinegar to taste.

For Dark Red Sauce: Mix BBQ sauce, Dijon honey mustard, ketchup, mayonnaise, Worcestershire, paprika, salt, pepper, and pickles with the remaining onion mixture. Add optional sriracha, red wine vinegar, or sweet relish if you like.
Taste each sauce and adjust seasoning as needed. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving to let flavors blend together.
recipes.description: Three signature burger sauces that'll take your burgers from ordinary to crave-worthy. Each one's got its own personality — tangy red, bright yellow mustard, or rich dark BBQ.

recipes.title: Crazy Good Sauces
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili crisp (like Lao Gan Ma)
directions: Add mayonnaise to a small bowl.
Stir in chili crisp until well combined, making sure to get some of the crispy bits mixed throughout.
Taste and add more chili crisp if you want it spicier.
Store covered in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.
recipes.description: A spicy, umami-packed mayo that takes about 30 seconds to make and turns any sandwich, burger, or fry into something special. This is one of those condiments you'll want to keep in your fridge at all times.

recipes.title: Tomato Salami Sandwich
ingredients: 4 slices garlic herb butter sourdough bread
directions: Toast the sourdough bread slices until golden and crispy.
Spread mayonnaise generously on one side of each toasted bread slice.
Layer the salami on 2 slices of bread, folding or stacking as needed.
Top the salami with tomato slices, then close each sandwich with the remaining bread slices, mayo side down.
Cut sandwiches in half and serve immediately.
recipes.description: A simple but satisfying sandwich that lets quality ingredients shine — crispy toasted sourdough spread thick with mayo, layers of thinly sliced salami, and fresh tomato slices.

recipes.title: Egg Salad Sandwich
ingredients: 8 slices garlic herb butter sourdough bread
6 strips bacon, cooked crispy and crumbled
directions: In a large bowl, combine mayo, mustard, sour cream, red pepper flakes, and black pepper. Mix well.
Add chopped eggs, bacon, pickles, celery, red onion, jalapeños, and red pepper to the bowl. Fold everything together until well combined.
Stir in dill, parsley, and thyme. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. Chill in fridge for at least 15 minutes.
Toast the sourdough bread slices until golden and crispy.
Pile egg salad generously onto 4 slices of toast. Top with cherry tomato halves and sprinkle with everything bagel seasoning.
Place remaining toast slices on top, cut sandwiches in half, and serve immediately.
recipes.description: A loaded egg salad sandwich piled high with crispy bacon, fresh veggies, and herbs on toasted garlic herb sourdough. This ain't your grandma's bland egg salad — it's got kick, crunch, and flavor in every bite.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad Sandwich
ingredients: 8 slices Garlic Herb Butter Sourdough Bread
Kettle cooked potato chips, for serving
directions: In a large bowl, combine the shredded chicken, crumbled bacon, diced apple, halved grapes, walnuts, almonds, red onion, and celery.
In a small bowl, whisk together the mayo and honey until smooth. Pour over the chicken mixture and stir until everything is well coated.
Fold in the crumbled feta cheese and season with salt and pepper to taste. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld.

Toast the sourdough bread slices until golden and crispy. Pile the chicken salad generously onto 4 slices of bread, top with the remaining slices, and serve with kettle cooked potato chips on the side.
recipes.description: A loaded chicken salad with crispy bacon, sweet fruit, and crunchy nuts piled high on toasted garlic herb sourdough. The honey-kissed mayo brings everything together for a sandwich that's way better than anything from the deli.

recipes.title: Creamed Spinach Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb ribeye or sirloin steak, thinly sliced
Salt and black pepper to taste
directions: Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 6-8 minutes. Remove and drain on paper towels. Pour off most of the bacon grease, leaving about 1 tablespoon in the pan.
Season steak slices with salt and pepper. In the same skillet over medium-high heat, cook steak slices for 2-3 minutes per side until browned and cooked to your liking. Remove and set aside.

Spread garlic herb butter on one side of each bread slice. Place butter-side down in the skillet and toast over medium heat until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes. Flip and top two slices with provolone cheese, letting it melt as the other side toasts.

Warm the creamed spinach in a small saucepan or microwave. Spread mayo on the non-buttered side of the bread slices without cheese. Layer steak, bacon, creamed spinach, red onion, and tomato on the cheesy bread slices. Top with the other bread slices and serve immediately.
recipes.description: A loaded steak sandwich that takes things up a notch with creamy spinach, crispy bacon, and melted provolone on garlic herb butter sourdough. This ain't your average sandwich — it's a knife-and-fork situation.

recipes.title: Cubano Sandwich
ingredients: 8 slices Garlic Herb Butter Sourdough Bread
1.5 lbs Mojo Mustard Seasoned Pork Shoulder, sliced or shredded
directions: Spread softened cream cheese on one side of 4 bread slices and adobo mayo on the other 4 slices.
On the cream cheese side, layer ham, mojo pork, Swiss cheese, red onion, and pickles. Add apple slices if using.
Top with the mayo-spread bread slices to close the sandwiches.
Heat a large skillet or griddle over medium heat. Press sandwiches down with a heavy pan or sandwich press and cook 3-4 minutes per side until bread is golden and cheese is melted.
Slice sandwiches in half and serve hot.
recipes.description: A loaded take on the classic Cuban sandwich with tender mojo pork, ham, and Swiss cheese on garlic herb sourdough, topped with tangy pickles and a kick of adobo mayo. This ain't your typical pressed sandwich — it's packed with flavor and a cream cheese spread that makes it unforgettable.

recipes.title: Salmon Cucumber Cream Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 8 slices garlic herb butter sourdough bread
directions: Cook the bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 8-10 minutes. Drain on paper towels and set aside.
Toast the sourdough bread slices until golden and crispy.
Spread honey cream cheese on 4 slices of toast and black pepper mayo on the other 4 slices.
On the cream cheese side, layer the smoked salmon, bacon, tomato slices, red onion, cucumber, and avocado.
Top with the mayo-spread toast slices, press down gently, and slice each sandwich in half. Serve immediately.
recipes.description: A loaded, everything-but-the-kitchen-sink sandwich piled high with smoked salmon, crispy bacon, and all the fresh fixings on garlicky sourdough. It's rich, smoky, and satisfying enough to be dinner.

recipes.title: Sausage Gravy Breakfast Sandwich
directions: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 6-8 minutes. Remove and set aside. In the same pan, cook ham slices for 1-2 minutes per side until lightly browned.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a skillet over medium-low heat. Add sliced onions with a pinch of salt and cook slowly, stirring occasionally, until golden and caramelized, about 15-20 minutes.
Toast sourdough bread slices until golden. Fry eggs in 2 tablespoons butter to your preferred doneness (over-easy or over-medium works great), seasoning with salt and pepper.

Warm the sausage gravy in a small saucepan. Spread chipotle mayo on 4 slices of toasted bread. Layer each sandwich with ham, bacon, a fried egg, cheddar cheese, tomato slices, jalapeño, and caramelized onions.
Generously ladle hot sausage gravy over the top of each sandwich, then place the remaining bread slices on top. Serve immediately with extra gravy on the side.
recipes.description: This isn't your average breakfast sandwich — it's a monster of a meal stacked with crispy bacon, ham, fried eggs, caramelized onions, and smothered in rich sausage gravy on toasted garlic herb sourdough. Perfect for when you need a serious Southern-style breakfast that'll stick with you all morning.

recipes.title: Turkey Avocado Bacon Garden Salad
ingredients: 4 slices Garlic Herb Butter Sourdough Bread
directions: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 8-10 minutes. Drain on paper towels and crumble or chop into pieces.
Toast the sourdough bread slices until golden and crispy, either in a toaster or under the broiler for 2-3 minutes per side.
Arrange the toasted sourdough on serving plates. Layer each with turkey slices, crispy bacon, avocado slices, onion, diced apples, and cucumber.
Drizzle generously with Thousand Island dressing and top with a handful of kettle chips for extra crunch. Serve immediately.
recipes.description: A hearty, loaded salad piled high with crispy bacon, tender turkey, fresh veggies, and crunchy apples, all served on toasted garlic herb sourdough with a creamy Thousand Island dressing. Perfect for a satisfying lunch that feels like a feast.

recipes.title: Tuna Salad Melt Sandwich
directions: Spread garlic herb butter on one side of each slice of sourdough bread.
In a small bowl, mix together the tuna salad and cream cheese until well combined.
Heat a large skillet or griddle over medium heat. Place 4 slices of bread butter-side down in the pan.
Spread the tuna mixture evenly on the bread slices in the pan, then top each with shredded cheddar cheese and a handful of jalapeño chips.
Place the remaining bread slices on top, butter-side up.
Cook for 3-4 minutes per side, pressing down gently with a spatula, until the bread is golden brown and toasted and the cheese is melted.
Remove from heat, cut sandwiches in half, and serve immediately while hot and melty.
recipes.description: A loaded tuna melt that takes the classic up a notch with cream cheese, sharp cheddar, and a satisfying crunch from jalapeño kettle chips. Perfect for when you want something comforting but with a little kick.

recipes.title: Tomato Bacon Mayo Sandwich
ingredients: 8 slices garlic herb butter sourdough bread
directions: Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 8-10 minutes. Drain on paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together mayonnaise, softened cream cheese, black pepper, and garlic salt until smooth and well combined.
Toast the sourdough bread slices in a skillet or toaster until golden brown.
Spread the cream cheese mayo mixture generously on all 8 slices of toasted bread.
Layer 3 slices of bacon and thick tomato slices on 4 pieces of bread, then top with remaining bread slices.
Cut sandwiches in half and serve immediately.
recipes.description: A loaded Southern-style BLT with creamy garlic herb butter sourdough, crispy bacon, fresh tomatoes, and a tangy cream cheese mayo spread that takes this classic sandwich to the next level.

recipes.title: Pepperoni Pizza Bacon Ranch Sandwich
ingredients: 8 slices Garlic Herb Butter Sourdough Bread
1 lb Hot Italian Sausage, removed from casings
1/2 cup Homemade Ranch blended with 2 tablespoons chopped Pepperoncini
directions: Cook the bacon until crispy, then set aside. In the same skillet, cook the Italian sausage over medium-high heat, breaking it into crumbles until browned and cooked through, about 6-8 minutes. Drain excess grease.
In a small bowl, blend the ranch dressing with chopped pepperoncini and set aside. Warm the vodka sauce in a small saucepan over low heat.

Butter one side of each bread slice with any extra garlic herb butter if needed. On the unbuttered side of 4 slices, layer the pepperoni, cooked sausage, bacon, red onion, and tomato slices. Sprinkle with garlic salt and Italian seasoning.
Drizzle vodka sauce over the fillings, then top generously with mozzarella cheese. Place sandwiches (open-faced) under the broiler for 2-3 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from broiler, drizzle with pepperoncini ranch, and top with remaining bread slices (buttered side out). Press gently and serve immediately.
recipes.description: This loaded sandwich is basically a pizza party between two slices of buttery garlic sourdough — crispy bacon, spicy Italian sausage, pepperoni, and melted mozzarella all brought together with vodka sauce and a tangy pepperoncini ranch.

recipes.title: Turkey Vodka Pesto Sandwich
ingredients: 8 slices garlic herb butter sourdough bread
1/2 cup mayonnaise mixed with 3 tablespoons pesto
directions: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 6-8 minutes. Drain on paper towels.
Toast sourdough bread slices in the bacon drippings or butter until golden brown on both sides.
Mix together mayonnaise and pesto in a small bowl. Spread pesto mayo on one side of each toasted bread slice.
On four bread slices, layer turkey, bacon, cheddar cheese, tomato slices, spinach, and red onion.
Drizzle warm vodka sauce over the toppings on each sandwich.
Top with remaining bread slices, press down gently, and serve immediately while cheese is melty.
recipes.description: This loaded sandwich takes turkey to the next level with crispy bacon, melted cheddar, and a double hit of Italian flavor from pesto mayo and warm vodka sauce on buttery toasted sourdough. It's messy, indulgent, and worth every napkin.

recipes.title: Pesto Capressi Pesto Sandwich
directions: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 6-8 minutes. Remove and drain on paper towels. In the same skillet, fry eggs to your liking.
Toast sourdough slices in butter until golden brown on both sides.
Spread pesto mayo generously on all 4 slices of toasted bread.
On 2 slices, layer salami, mozzarella, tomato slices, bacon, fried egg, pickled red onions, and arugula.
Drizzle balsamic glaze over the top, then close sandwiches with remaining bread slices. Cut in half and serve immediately.
recipes.description: A loaded Italian-inspired sandwich stacked high with salami, crispy bacon, fried egg, and fresh mozzarella, all held together with pesto mayo on toasted garlic herb sourdough. It's got everything you want in a sandwich — crispy, creamy, tangy, and rich.

recipes.title: Ruben Sandwich
directions: Butter one side of each sourdough slice with the softened butter.
Heat a large skillet or griddle over medium heat. Place 4 bread slices butter-side down.
Layer each sandwich starting with pastrami, salami, 2 slices provolone, sauerkraut, caramelized onions, pickles, tomato slices, and fried onion strips. Drizzle with Thousand Island dressing.
Top with remaining bread slices, butter-side up. Press down gently with a spatula.
Cook 3-4 minutes per side until bread is golden brown and cheese is melted, pressing occasionally.
Remove from heat, let rest 1 minute, then slice diagonally and serve hot.
recipes.description: This ain't your deli's basic Ruben — it's a monster sandwich piled high with honeyed pastrami, salami, and all the fixings on buttery garlic herb sourdough. Every bite's got that perfect mix of savory, tangy, and sweet with a satisfying crunch.

recipes.title: Pastrami Swiss Sandwich
directions: Butter one side of each slice of sourdough bread with the softened butter.
Heat a large skillet or griddle over medium heat. Place 4 slices of bread butter-side down in the pan.
On each slice in the pan, layer 4 oz pastrami, then top with Swiss and provolone cheese slices. Let cook until cheese begins to melt, about 3-4 minutes.
While cheese melts, spread mustard and mayo on the remaining 4 bread slices.
Top the melted cheese with sliced onions and pickles.
Place the mustard-mayo bread slices on top, butter-side up, and carefully flip each sandwich.
Cook until bottom bread is golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes, then flip once more to crisp up the other side if needed.
Remove from heat, slice in half diagonally, and serve hot.
recipes.description: A loaded deli-style sandwich piled high with tender pastrami, melted cheese, and tangy condiments on buttery garlic herb sourdough. This is the kind of sandwich that requires two hands and plenty of napkins.

recipes.title: Ham, Egg and Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 2 slices Garlic Herb Butter Sourdough Bread
directions: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 6-8 minutes. Remove and drain on paper towels.
In the same skillet, warm the ham slices for about 1 minute per side. Set aside.
Melt butter in the skillet and fry the egg to your liking. Season with adobo seasoning while cooking.
Toast the sourdough bread slices until golden brown.
Spread mayonnaise on both slices of bread. Layer one slice with ham, bacon, cheddar cheese, caramelized onions, pickles, and the fried egg.
Top with the second slice of bread and serve immediately while everything is hot and melty.
recipes.description: A loaded breakfast sandwich piled high with crispy bacon, savory ham, a perfectly fried egg, and melted cheddar cheese on buttery garlic herb sourdough. The caramelized onions and pickles add just the right amount of sweet and tangy bite.

recipes.title: BBQ Ranch Pulled Pork Sandwich
ingredients: 2 lbs smoked BBQ sauce covered pork shoulder, pulled
1/2 cup hot sauce cream cheese, softened
1 cup corn kernels, grilled or roasted
4 large sandwich buns or ciabatta rolls
directions: If pork shoulder is cold, reheat it gently in a skillet or microwave until warmed through, keeping it saucy.
Toast the sandwich buns lightly and spread hot sauce cream cheese on the bottom bun of each sandwich.
Pile pulled pork onto each bottom bun, then top with 2 slices of pepper jack cheese (let residual heat melt it slightly).
Layer on bacon onion jam, pickled red onions, candied jalapeños, apple slices, corn, and fried pickle chips.
Drizzle homemade ranch dressing generously over the toppings.
Crown each sandwich with a handful of crispy onion rings, then add the top bun.
Serve immediately with extra napkins — these are messy in the best way.
recipes.description: A loaded Southern-style pulled pork sandwich piled high with all the fixings — smoky BBQ pork topped with pepper jack, spicy cream cheese, pickled onions, candied jalapeños, and crispy onion rings. This ain't your average sandwich.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Bacon Ranch Sandwich
ingredients: 4 slices garlic herb butter sourdough bread
2 medium tomatoes, sliced thick and fried
directions: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 8-10 minutes. Drain on paper towels and set aside.
Season chicken breast slices with salt and pepper, then cook in the same skillet (using bacon fat) over medium-high heat until golden and cooked through, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Toast sourdough bread slices in a skillet or on a griddle until golden and crispy on both sides.
Spread Frank's Red Hot mayo on two slices of bread. Layer with pepper jack cheese, cooked chicken, bacon, fried tomatoes, pickles, lettuce, fried onion strips, pickled red onions, and jalapeños.
Drizzle homemade ranch over the toppings, then crumble rosemary goat cheese on top.
Top with remaining bread slices, press down gently, and slice in half to serve.
recipes.description: A loaded, over-the-top sandwich piled high with crispy bacon, tender chicken, and every fixins you can imagine — all brought together with tangy buffalo mayo and creamy ranch on buttery toasted sourdough.

recipes.title: Spicy Italian Sandwich
ingredients: 1 loaf sourdough bread with garlic herb butter
3 tablespoons mayonnaise mixed with 1 tablespoon chili garlic paste
directions: Roast garlic cloves wrapped in foil at 400°F for 25-30 minutes until soft and golden. Mash and spread on the inside of the bread if desired.
Toast the garlic herb sourdough bread slices until lightly golden and crispy.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, Italian herbs, and 1 tablespoon mayonnaise to make the dressing.
Spread chili garlic paste mayo on both slices of toasted bread.
Layer the meats on the bottom slice: salami, pastrami, pepperoni, ham, then bacon. Top with pepper jack cheese slices.
Add red onion, tomato, pickles, jalapeño, lettuce, pepperoncini, and cherry peppers.
Drizzle the herb vinaigrette over the vegetables, close the sandwich, and slice in half.
Serve immediately with jalapeño kettle chips on the side.
recipes.description: A loaded Italian deli sandwich piled high with four kinds of cured meats, crispy bacon, and pepper jack cheese, then topped with pickled peppers, fresh veggies, and a tangy herb vinaigrette on toasted garlic bread. This is the kind of sandwich that requires both hands and a big appetite.

recipes.title: Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 4 slices garlic herb butter sourdough bread
1 lb sliced peppered steak (ribeye or sirloin, cooked to preference)
1/4 cup Dijon mayo mixed with 1 tsp fresh thyme and 1 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped
1/2 red onion, thinly sliced and marinated in 2 tbsp lemon juice
1 red bell pepper, roasted and sliced
1/2 cup fried onion strips (store-bought or homemade)
directions: Cook or reheat the peppered steak slices in a hot skillet until warmed through, about 2-3 minutes per side. Set aside and keep warm.
Toast the sourdough bread slices in a skillet or under the broiler until golden and crispy, about 2 minutes per side.
Spread the Dijon mayo mixture on two slices of bread and the rosemary horseradish mayo on the other two slices.

Layer the bottom slices with arugula, then add the warm steak, Dubliner cheese (let it melt slightly from the warm steak), caramelized onions and garlic, roasted red pepper, tomato, jalapeño slices, and lemon-marinated red onion.
Top generously with fried onion strips for crunch, then cap with the remaining bread slices, mayo-side down.
Press down gently, slice in half if desired, and serve immediately while the steak is still warm.
recipes.description: A loaded steak sandwich piled high with peppered beef, two different gourmet mayos, caramelized onions, and crispy fried onion strips on buttery garlic herb sourdough. This isn't your average sandwich — it's a full-on flavor bomb that eats like a meal.

recipes.title: Carne Asada Sandwich
ingredients: 4 slices garlic herb and butter sourdough bread
1 lb carne asada steak, grilled and chopped
1/4 cup chili lime mayo mixed with 1 tablespoon Cholula hot sauce
directions: Roast the poblano pepper and jalapeño over an open flame or under the broiler until charred. Place in a covered bowl for 5 minutes to steam, then peel off the skin, remove seeds, and slice into strips.
Toast the sourdough bread slices in a skillet with a little butter until golden and crispy on both sides.
Spread chipotle mayo on two slices of bread and the chili lime mayo mixture on the other two slices.
Layer the chopped carne asada on the chipotle mayo slices, then top with pepper jack cheese slices.
Add the guacamole with feta, crumbled cotija cheese, pickled red onions, roasted poblano and jalapeño strips, and fresh cilantro.
Top with the remaining bread slices (mayo side down) and press gently to hold everything together. Slice in half and serve immediately.
recipes.description: A loaded Southern-style steak sandwich piled high with smoky carne asada, creamy guac, tangy pickled onions, and roasted peppers on buttery toasted sourdough. This isn't your basic sandwich — it's a flavor-packed meal that'll have you coming back for seconds.

recipes.title: Roast Beef Sandwich
directions: Butter both slices of sourdough bread on one side. Heat a skillet over medium heat and toast the bread butter-side down until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes. Set aside.
In a small bowl, mix together the Dijon mustard and mayonnaise until combined.
In the same skillet, fry the egg to your liking (over-easy or over-medium works best for sandwiches). Season with cracked black pepper.
Build the sandwich: spread horseradish mayo on one slice of toasted bread. Layer with Dubliner cheese, roast beef, salami, pickles, red onion, pepperoncini, tomato, and lettuce.
Spread the Dijon-mayo mixture on the other slice of bread. Top the sandwich with the fried egg, then close it up.
Cut in half if desired and serve immediately while the egg is still warm.
recipes.description: This loaded roast beef sandwich is stacked high with deli meats, tangy pickles, crisp vegetables, and a fried egg on buttered sourdough. It's got everything you want in a sandwich — creamy, crunchy, savory, and just a little heat.

recipes.title: Fancy Club Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 cup caramelized onion and bacon jam
directions: Make the spreads: In one bowl, mix together 1/2 cup mayo, yellow mustard, and 3 tablespoons diced pickles. In another bowl, mix 1/4 cup mayo with 2 tablespoons diced pickles. Set both aside.
Butter one side of all 9 slices of sourdough bread. Toast the bread butter-side down in a skillet over medium heat until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Build the first layer: Spread mustard-pickle mayo on one slice of toasted bread. Top with ham, salami, white cheddar, tomato slices, and kettle chips. Place second slice of bread on top.
Build the second layer: Spread pickle mayo on top of the second bread slice. Add turkey, lots of bacon, caramelized onion bacon jam, red onion, and lettuce. Place third slice of bread on top.
Top the sandwich with a fried egg and shaved parmesan cheese. Secure the whole stack with long toothpicks or skewers.
Cut the sandwich in half diagonally and serve immediately while the egg is still runny.
recipes.description: This isn't your average club sandwich — it's a three-decker monster loaded with multiple meats, fried egg, caramelized onion bacon jam, and two different homemade spreads. Stack it high, press it down, and get ready for the best sandwich you've ever made.

recipes.title: Spam and Eggs Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dried herbs (Italian seasoning or parsley)
directions: Mix together the softened butter, garlic powder, and dried herbs. Spread on both sides of the sourdough slices and toast in a skillet over medium heat until golden brown. Set aside.

In the same skillet, cook the bacon until crispy, then remove and drain on paper towels. Cook the spam slices in the bacon fat until browned and crispy on both sides, about 3-4 minutes per side. Remove and set aside.
Sauté the sliced yellow onion in the remaining fat until softened and caramelized, about 8-10 minutes. Push to the side and fry the eggs to your preferred doneness.
Make the sauce by mixing together mayonnaise, sour cream, hot sauce, thyme, and parsley in a small bowl.

Build the sandwiches: spread the herb mayo on the toasted bread, then layer with lettuce, tomato, sautéed onions, bacon, spam, fried egg, pickled red onions, and feta cheese. Top with the other slice of bread and serve immediately.
recipes.description: A loaded breakfast sandwich that takes things up a notch with crispy spam, bacon, and a tangy herb mayo. It's got everything you want between two slices of buttery sourdough — perfect for when you're really hungry.

recipes.title: Pork Shoulder Tikka Masala Crockpot
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 2-inch chunks
2 large potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch chunks
directions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown the pork shoulder chunks in butter for 3-4 minutes per side, then transfer to the crockpot.

Add the red onion, yellow onion, garlic, jalapeños, serrano peppers, potatoes, crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, garam masala, ginger, coriander, cumin, smoked paprika, turmeric, cayenne, and red pepper flakes to the crockpot. Stir well to combine.
Cover and cook on low for 7-8 hours or high for 4-5 hours, until pork is fall-apart tender and potatoes are cooked through.
About 30 minutes before serving, stir in the heavy cream, Greek yogurt, goat cheese, and paneer cubes. Continue cooking until cheeses are melted and sauce is creamy.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt as needed. Garnish with fresh parsley, cilantro, and pickled red onions.
Serve over white rice with extra pickled red onions on the side.
recipes.description: A Southern twist on the Indian classic, this slow-cooked pork shoulder gets fall-apart tender in a rich, creamy tomato-based sauce loaded with warm spices. Serve it over white rice for a comforting dinner that'll have everyone coming back for seconds.

recipes.title: Salami Cheddar Pickle Sandwich
ingredients: 8 slices garlic herb butter sourdough bread
directions: Lay out 4 slices of sourdough bread and spread about 1 tablespoon of mayo on each slice.
Layer 3 oz of salami on each slice, folding the slices to create height and texture.
Add 2 oz of cheddar cheese on top of the salami on each sandwich.
Top the cheese with pickle slices, distributing evenly across the 4 sandwiches.
Place the remaining 4 slices of bread on top and press down gently.
Cut each sandwich in half and serve immediately, or wrap tightly for lunch later.
recipes.description: A satisfying deli-style sandwich with thin-sliced salami, sharp cheddar, and tangy pickles on garlic herb butter sourdough. Perfect for a quick lunch that's got way more flavor than your average cold sandwich.

recipes.title: Will Ferrel’s Favorite Sandwich
ingredients: 1 large grapefruit, supremed (segments removed from membrane)
directions: Spread garlic herb butter on one side of each slice of sourdough bread.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and toast the bread butter-side down until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Spread mayonnaise generously on the untoasted side of 2 slices of bread.
Layer the salami evenly over the mayo, then top with grapefruit segments.
Close the sandwiches with the remaining toasted bread slices, butter-side up.
Cut in half and serve immediately while the bread is still warm.
recipes.description: This quirky sandwich hits all the right notes with salty salami, tangy grapefruit, and rich garlic butter toast. It's weird, it's wonderful, and it actually works.

recipes.title: Crazy Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 cups lard or beef tallow (for frying)
Your choice of sauce(s) from the master list
Your choice of toppings based on sandwich theme (pickles, sliced tomatoes, shredded lettuce, pickled red onions, coleslaw, cheese, bacon, etc.)
directions: Pound chicken thighs to even thickness (about 1/2-inch thick). In a large bowl, whisk together buttermilk and eggs. Add chicken and marinate for at least 30 minutes (or up to overnight in the fridge).

Set up your breading station: In one shallow dish, mix flour, potato starch, chicken bouillon powder, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, and cayenne. Add any additional spices based on your chosen sandwich theme (curry powder, Italian seasoning, jerk seasoning, etc.).

Heat lard or tallow in a large cast-iron skillet or Dutch oven to 350°F. Remove chicken from buttermilk marinade, letting excess drip off. Dredge in seasoned flour mixture, press firmly to coat, dip back in buttermilk, then dredge again in flour for a thick double coating.
Fry chicken thighs 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165°F. Don't overcrowd the pan. Drain on a wire rack.
While chicken rests, butter both sides of buns and toast in a skillet until golden. Prepare your chosen sauce and toppings for the sandwich variety you're making.
Build your sandwich: Bottom bun, sauce, fried chicken thigh, additional sauce if desired, themed toppings (refer to master list for ideas), top bun. Serve immediately while hot and crispy.
recipes.description: A master collection of over 120 outrageously creative fried chicken sandwiches, each with its own flavor profile and topping combination. Every sandwich starts with juicy chicken thighs fried in tallow or lard with a seasoned wet-and-dry batter, then loaded up with unique sauces and toppings that match the theme.

recipes.title: Chicken Olive Feta Hummus Wrap
ingredients: Salt and vinegar fries, for serving
directions: Mix the lemon pepper cream cheese into the cooked white rice until well combined. Set aside.
Warm the tortillas slightly to make them pliable. Spread a layer of roasted red pepper hummus down the center of each wrap, followed by a drizzle of white roasted garlic sauce.
Layer the chopped rotisserie chicken over the hummus, then add the lemon pepper rice mixture.
Top with green olive whipped feta, diced tomatoes, cucumbers, jalapeños, pickled red onions, and fresh parsley.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla and roll tightly from bottom to top to form a wrap.
Slice in half on the diagonal and serve immediately with salt and vinegar fries on the side.
recipes.description: A loaded Mediterranean-style wrap packed with rotisserie chicken, roasted red pepper hummus, whipped feta, and all the fresh toppings. Served with crispy salt and vinegar fries for the ultimate handheld meal.

recipes.title: Buffalo Carne Asada Blue Cheese Wrap
ingredients: 1 lb carne asada steak, grilled and sliced thin
6 strips bacon, cooked crispy and chopped
1 cup buffalo coleslaw (coleslaw mix tossed with buffalo sauce)
1/4 cup buffalo blue cheese sauce (equal parts sour cream and mayo mixed with buffalo sauce and blue cheese crumbles)
directions: Toss the sliced carne asada with buffalo sauce in a bowl until well coated, then warm it in a skillet over medium heat for 2-3 minutes.
Warm the flour tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave for 15-20 seconds to make them pliable.
Lay out each tortilla and spread 2 tablespoons of the buffalo blue cheese sauce down the center, leaving space at the edges.
Layer on the buffalo carne asada, bacon, Mexican cheese, blue cheese crumbles, buffalo coleslaw, celery, pickled red onion, pickled jalapeños, tomatoes, and romaine lettuce.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from the bottom up, tucking as you go to keep everything inside.
Slice each wrap in half on the diagonal and serve with kettle cooked chips on the side.
recipes.description: A loaded buffalo-style wrap that brings the heat with spicy carne asada, crispy bacon, and a cool blue cheese kick. This is the kind of wrap that eats like a full meal — messy, satisfying, and packed with bold flavors.

recipes.title: BBQ Steak Wraps
ingredients: ½ cup red onions, thinly sliced
2 teaspoons Devil Spit hot sauce (or similar)
directions: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 8-10 minutes. Drain on paper towels and set aside. Season steak generously on both sides with BBQ rub.
Heat the same skillet over medium-high heat and cook steak 4-5 minutes per side for medium, or to desired doneness. Let rest 5 minutes, then slice thin against the grain.
Mix together mayonnaise, sour cream, and Devil Spit hot sauce in a small bowl to make the spicy sauce.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave for 20 seconds. Lay each tortilla flat and spread a layer of the spicy mayo-sour cream mixture down the center.
Layer each wrap with romaine lettuce, sliced steak, bacon, BBQ coleslaw, tomatoes, red onions, jalapeños, and pickles.
Top with fried onion straws, fold in the sides of the tortilla, and roll up tightly from bottom to top.
Cut wraps in half diagonally and serve immediately with jalapeño kettle chips, baked beans, and cornbread on the side.
recipes.description: A loaded BBQ steak wrap packed with crispy bacon, tangy coleslaw, and all the fixings. This is the kind of wrap that needs both hands and a stack of napkins.

recipes.title: Cajun Shrimp and Sausage Burrito
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
12 oz andouille sausage, sliced into rounds
1 cup Chipotle Chalula Cajun homemade ranch (or store-bought chipotle ranch)
2 cups red beans and Spanish rice, prepared
directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Season shrimp and sausage with Cajun seasoning and cook for 5-7 minutes until shrimp are pink and sausage is browned. Set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté red onion and corn for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave for 20 seconds to make them pliable. Lay each tortilla flat and layer with red beans and rice down the center, leaving 2 inches on each side.
Top the rice with shrimp and sausage mixture, sautéed onions and corn, Cajun coleslaw, jalapeños, and shredded cheese. Drizzle generously with chipotle Cajun ranch.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from bottom to top, tucking as you go to keep everything inside.
Optional: Place burritos seam-side down in a hot skillet for 2 minutes per side to crisp up the tortilla and melt the cheese.
Slice in half diagonally and serve with kettle cooked chips on the side and extra ranch for dipping.
recipes.description: A loaded burrito packed with Cajun-seasoned shrimp and sausage, creamy coleslaw, and all the fixings that'll make you forget about your local burrito shop. Crispy kettle chips on the side complete this Louisiana-meets-Mexico fusion feast.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Chicken Wrap
directions: Cook chicken in a skillet over medium-high heat until done, about 6-8 minutes. Add 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce and toss to coat. Set aside.
Mix cooked rice with lemon pepper seasoning. In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce, and sour cream to make teriyaki mayo.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave for 15 seconds to make them pliable.
Lay tortillas flat and spread teriyaki mayo down the center. Layer with lemon pepper rice, teriyaki chicken, red onion, green pepper, cucumber, pineapple, and coleslaw.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from bottom to top. Cut in half on the diagonal.
Serve immediately with kettle cooked chips on the side.
recipes.description: A loaded teriyaki chicken wrap packed with sweet pineapple, crisp veggies, and tangy coleslaw, all wrapped up with lemon pepper rice and a creamy teriyaki mayo. Serve it with kettle chips for a satisfying lunch that beats any takeout.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Bacon Ranch Wrap
ingredients: 4 slices bacon, cooked crispy and chopped
directions: Warm the flour tortilla in a dry skillet over medium heat for 30 seconds per side to make it pliable.
Spread the softened cream cheese down the center of the tortilla, leaving 2 inches on each end.
Layer the buffalo chicken, bacon, cheddar cheese, tomato, fried pickles, red onion, cucumber, jalapenos, and romaine lettuce over the cream cheese.
Drizzle the buffalo ranch over the fillings and top with fried onion strings.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from the bottom up to form a wrap.
Slice the wrap in half diagonally and serve immediately with kettle cooked chips on the side.
recipes.description: A loaded wrap packed with spicy buffalo chicken, crispy bacon, and all the fixings, then drizzled with homemade buffalo ranch. This is the kind of sandwich that requires both hands and a stack of napkins.

recipes.title: Honey Chili Garlic Chicken Wrap
ingredients: 1 egg roll, fried and mashed up
directions: In a bowl, toss the chopped fried chicken with honey and chili garlic sauce until well coated.
In a small bowl, mix together chili crisp oil, sour cream, and mayonnaise to make the spicy sauce.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave for 20-30 seconds to make them pliable.
Layer each tortilla with fried rice down the center, then top with honey chili garlic chicken, Asian slaw, sliced onions, and red peppers.
Add mashed up egg roll pieces on top, then drizzle with the chili crisp mayo sauce.
Top each wrap with a fried egg, then fold in the sides and roll up tightly, tucking as you go.
Cut in half on the diagonal and serve immediately while everything is warm and the egg yolk is still runny.
recipes.description: A loaded wrap that packs crispy honey chili garlic chicken, fried rice, and crunchy Asian slaw into one massive handheld feast. Drizzled with spicy chili crisp mayo and topped with a fried egg, this is the kind of wrap that requires two hands and zero regrets.

recipes.title: Asian Peanut Butter Wrap
ingredients: 2 cups cooked Peanut Butter Chicken, diced or shredded
6 strips bacon, cooked crispy and chopped
1/4 cup sour cream mixed with 1 tablespoon chili garlic paste
1 red apple, julienned or thinly sliced
1 cup Crispy Chili Oil French Fries
directions: Lay out the flour tortillas and spread 2 tablespoons of softened cream cheese on each one, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Layer the peanut butter chicken down the center of each tortilla, then top with chopped bacon, cucumber slaw, diced onion, red pepper slices, jalapeños, and apple slices.
Drizzle the spicy peanut sauce over the filling, then add a generous dollop of the chili garlic sour cream on top.
Add a handful of the chili oil fries right into the wrap, then sprinkle with crushed honey roasted peanuts.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from bottom to top to form a wrap. Cut in half on the diagonal and serve immediately while the fries are still crispy.
recipes.description: A loaded wrap that packs serious flavor with tender peanut butter chicken, crispy bacon, crunchy Asian slaw, and spicy peanut sauce all rolled up with cream cheese and topped with honey roasted peanuts. Toss in some chili oil fries right in the wrap for an over-the-top crunch factor.

recipes.title: BBQ Pork Shoulder Chipotle Slaw Wrap
ingredients: 1 lb BBQ chopped pork shoulder, warmed
1 cup crispy chili oil french fries
3 tablespoons Taco Bell creamy jalapeño sauce
directions: Warm the flour tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave for 15-20 seconds until pliable.
Spread 2 tablespoons jalapeño cream cheese down the center of each tortilla, leaving 2 inches at the top and bottom.
Layer half the warm BBQ pork shoulder on each tortilla, followed by chipotle slaw, crumbled cornbread, corn, sliced jalapeños, pickled red onions, and avocado slices.
Add a handful of crispy fries to each wrap, drizzle with Taco Bell creamy jalapeño sauce, and top with crushed jalapeño kettle chips.
Fold the bottom of the tortilla up, then fold in the sides and roll tightly from bottom to top.
Cut each wrap in half on a diagonal and serve immediately while the fries are still crispy.
recipes.description: A loaded Southern-style wrap packed with smoky pulled pork, tangy chipotle slaw, and all the fixings — this thing is basically a BBQ plate rolled up in a tortilla. Crispy fries and jalapeño kettle chips add crunch that takes it over the top.

recipes.title: Taco Bell Creamy Jalapeno Sauce
directions: Finely chop the pickled jalapeños and set aside.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise and sour cream until smooth.
Add the jalapeño juice, chopped jalapeños, paprika, chili powder, cumin, garlic salt, and onion powder to the bowl.
Stir everything together until well combined and smooth.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld together before serving.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed — add more jalapeño juice for tanginess or more jalapeños for extra heat.
recipes.description: A tangy, creamy sauce with just the right kick of jalapeño heat that tastes just like the Taco Bell favorite. Perfect for drizzling on tacos, burritos, or using as a dip for chips and quesadillas.

recipes.title: Carne Asada Tzatziki Wrap
ingredients: 1½ lbs lemon pepper carne asada, grilled and sliced
1 cup crushed jalapeño kettle cooked chips
¼ cup roasted garlic hummus cream cheese
directions: Grill or pan-sear the carne asada over high heat for 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through. Let rest 5 minutes, then slice against the grain into thin strips.
Warm the flour tortillas in a dry skillet for 20-30 seconds per side until pliable.
Spread a thin layer of roasted garlic hummus cream cheese down the center of each tortilla, followed by a layer of whipped feta and a drizzle of tzatziki sauce.
Layer on the romaine lettuce, sliced carne asada, pickled red onions, cucumbers, jalapeños, corn relish, and cherry tomatoes.
Sprinkle with fresh parsley and cilantro, then add a handful of crushed jalapeño chips for crunch. Drizzle with lemon juice.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from the bottom up, tucking as you go to keep everything secure.
Slice each wrap in half on the diagonal and serve immediately while the chips are still crunchy.
recipes.description: A flavor-packed fusion wrap that brings together smoky lemon pepper carne asada with cool tzatziki and whipped feta, all wrapped up with crunchy veggies and a surprise layer of kettle chips for extra texture.

recipes.title: Southwestern Sauce Burrito
ingredients: 1 cup corn kernels (fresh or canned, drained)
1 cup black beans, drained and rinsed
1/2 cup Greek yogurt (or 1/4 cup mayo plus 1/4 cup sour cream)
directions: Make the chipotle sauce: In a bowl, combine jalapeño cream cheese, Greek yogurt, minced chipotle peppers, Chipotle Cholula, minced garlic, lime juice, cilantro, chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne, black pepper, smoked paprika, cumin, and honey. Mix until smooth and well combined.

Prep your burrito fillings: Warm the shredded chicken if needed. Have all vegetables prepped and ready — lettuce, tomatoes, bell pepper, corn, black beans, avocado, pickled onions, bacon, and cheddar cheese.
Warm the tomato basil wraps in a dry skillet or microwave for 15-20 seconds to make them pliable. Spread a generous layer of the chipotle sauce down the center of each wrap.

Layer the fillings down the center: Start with chicken, then add bacon, black beans, corn, bell pepper, tomatoes, pickled onions, avocado, lettuce, and cheddar cheese. Fold in the sides and roll up tightly, tucking as you go. Slice in half and serve with extra sauce on the side.
recipes.description: A loaded Southwestern burrito packed with seasoned chicken, bacon, and fresh veggies, all wrapped up with a creamy, smoky chipotle sauce that brings serious heat and flavor.

recipes.title: Carne Asada Chimmichuri Burrito
ingredients: 1 lb chili lime carne asada, grilled and sliced
6 strips bacon, cooked crispy and chopped
1 cup diced tomatoes, seasoned with lemon pepper
1/4 cup Cholula hot sauce sour cream
1 cup taco seasoned black beans, warmed
1 cup cilantro chili lime white rice, warmed
directions: Warm the flour tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave until pliable.
Layer the cilantro chili lime rice down the center of each tortilla, followed by the taco seasoned black beans.
Add the sliced carne asada, chopped bacon, both cheeses, and shredded romaine lettuce.
Top with guacamole, corn relish, jalapeños, lemon pepper tomatoes, and pickled red onions.
Drizzle with red chimichurri sauce, Cholula sour cream, and cilantro lime crema.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then tightly roll from bottom to top to form a burrito.
Optional: toast the burrito seam-side down in a hot skillet for 2-3 minutes to seal and crisp the outside.
Cut in half and serve immediately with extra sauces on the side.
recipes.description: A loaded monster burrito packed with chili lime carne asada, bacon, and all the fixings — chimichurri sauce, guacamole, corn relish, and enough toppings to make every bite different. This is the kind of burrito you need to eat over a plate.

recipes.title: Chipotle Ground Beef Mexican Burrito
ingredients: 1 can (4 oz) diced green chilies, drained
directions: Cook ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks. Drain excess fat, then stir in 2 tablespoons taco seasoning and cook 2 more minutes. Set aside.
Mix cooked rice with minced garlic and 1 tablespoon taco seasoning. Warm refried beans in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring occasionally.
Make chipotle lime mayo by mixing mayonnaise, lime juice, and chipotle powder in a small bowl. In another bowl, mix sour cream with Cholula hot sauce.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave until pliable. Layer each tortilla with refried beans, seasoned rice, ground beef, cheese, green chilies, tomatoes, red onion, and pickled jalapeños.
Top with shredded lettuce and cilantro, then drizzle with both sauces. Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from bottom to top.
Optional: Place burritos seam-side down in a hot skillet for 2-3 minutes to crisp the outside and melt the cheese.
recipes.description: A loaded burrito packed with seasoned ground beef, garlicky rice, and all the fixings. This is the kind of burrito that needs two hands and plenty of napkins.

recipes.title: BBQ Chopped Pork Shoulder Burritos
ingredients: 2 cups chopped smoked BBQ pork shoulder, warmed
2 cups crispy Cajun fries, freshly cooked
2 roasted poblano peppers, peeled and sliced
directions: Mix together sour cream, BBQ sauce, and mayonnaise in a small bowl until well combined. Set aside.
Warm the flour tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave until pliable, about 30 seconds each.
Lay out each tortilla and layer down the center: warmed pork shoulder, baked beans, roasted poblano strips, diced tomatoes, jalapeños, and pickled red onions.
Top with a generous handful of shredded cheese, a scoop of crispy Cajun fries, and fried onion strips.
Drizzle the BBQ-mayo sour cream over the fillings.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from bottom to top to form a burrito.
Optional: toast the burrito seam-side down in a hot skillet for 2-3 minutes to crisp up the outside and melt the cheese.
Slice in half and serve immediately with extra sauce on the side.
recipes.description: A loaded burrito that takes leftover smoked pork shoulder to the next level with crispy fries, tangy pickled onions, and a creamy BBQ-mayo sauce. It's messy, indulgent, and worth every napkin.

recipes.title: California Burrito
ingredients: 1 lb carne asada steak, grilled and sliced
6 strips bacon, cooked crispy and chopped
2 cups frozen French fries, cooked crispy and seasoned with Cajun seasoning
directions: Cook the French fries according to package directions until extra crispy, then toss with 1-2 teaspoons Cajun seasoning while hot. Set aside.
Season and grill the carne asada over high heat for 3-4 minutes per side, then let rest 5 minutes before slicing thin against the grain. Cook bacon until crispy and chop into bite-sized pieces.
Fry the eggs in a skillet to your preference (over-easy or over-medium works best for burrito filling).

Warm the flour tortillas in a dry skillet or over an open flame until pliable. Lay each tortilla flat and layer ingredients down the center: half the carne asada, bacon, one fried egg, cheese, crispy fries, guacamole, pickled onions, sour cream, and drizzle with Thousand Island dressing.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from bottom to top, tucking as you go to keep everything contained.
Optional: Place the rolled burrito seam-side down in a hot skillet for 1-2 minutes per side to crisp up the outside and melt the cheese. Slice in half and serve immediately.
recipes.description: This loaded California burrito is packed with crispy carne asada, bacon, a fried egg, and seasoned fries all wrapped up with creamy guac and tangy pickled onions. It's a hearty, indulgent burrito that brings that West Coast food truck flavor right to your kitchen.

recipes.title: Carne Asada Caesar Wrap
ingredients: 1 lb carne asada, grilled and sliced
6 strips bacon, cooked crispy and chopped
1 cup crispy garlic parmesan fries (store-bought or homemade)
directions: Cook the carne asada to desired doneness, let rest 5 minutes, then slice into thin strips. Cook bacon until crispy and chop into pieces.
Warm the flour tortillas on a skillet or in the microwave for 20-30 seconds to make them pliable.
Lay out each tortilla and layer down the center: romaine lettuce, sliced carne asada, bacon, red onion, tomato, avocado, and pepperoncini peppers.
Add the crispy garlic parmesan fries right on top of the other ingredients, then sprinkle generously with Parmesan cheese and crouton crumbles.
