Drizzle lots of Caesar dressing over everything (don't be shy).
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from the bottom up, tucking as you go to keep everything inside.
Cut in half on the diagonal and serve immediately while the fries are still crispy.
recipes.description: A hearty wrap packed with tender carne asada, crispy bacon, and all the Caesar salad fixings, plus a surprise crunch from garlic parmesan fries tucked right inside. This is the kind of loaded wrap that eats like a full meal.

recipes.title: Crazy Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 tablespoons seasoning blend (varies per sandwich style)
4 lbs lard or beef tallow for frying
8 yellow potato buns or brioche buns
Your choice of sauce (varies per sandwich — see master list)
Your choice of toppings (varies per sandwich — pickles, slaw, cheese, etc.)
directions: Prepare breading station: In one bowl, whisk together buttermilk and eggs. In another bowl, combine flour, potato starch, chicken bouillon, and seasonings appropriate to your chosen sandwich style (curry powder for Tikka Masala, Cajun spices for Buffalo, etc.).

Pound chicken thighs to even thickness. Dip each thigh in buttermilk mixture, then dredge in seasoned flour mixture, pressing firmly to coat. For extra crispy coating, double-dip: back in buttermilk, then flour again.

Heat lard or tallow in a large cast iron skillet or Dutch oven to 350°F. Fry chicken thighs 5-7 minutes per side until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165°F. Work in batches to avoid crowding. Drain on wire rack.
While chicken rests, butter both sides of buns and toast in a skillet until golden. Prepare your chosen sauce and toppings based on the sandwich style you're making.
Build sandwich: Bottom bun, fried chicken thigh, generous amount of sauce, toppings that complement your chosen flavor profile, top bun. Serve immediately while chicken is hot and crispy.
recipes.description: This is your master guide to creating over 120 wild and creative fried chicken sandwiches, each with its own unique sauce, seasoning, and toppings. Every sandwich starts with crispy lard-fried chicken thighs on buttered potato buns, then goes in a completely different flavor direction — from classic Buffalo to crazy combos like Blueberry Bacon Banana PB.

recipes.title: Nashville Hot Chicken Wrap
ingredients: 2 cups fried Nashville hot chicken, chopped
1 1/2 cups Cajun seasoned French fries, cooked
2 tablespoons Dave's Hot Chicken Sauce (or to taste)
directions: Cook the Cajun fries according to package directions until crispy, then set aside.
Warm the flour tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave for 15-20 seconds to make them pliable.
Layer each tortilla with half the fried chicken, habanero cheddar, pickles, red onion, tomatoes, jalapeños, and coleslaw down the center.
Add half the hot Cajun fries on top of the other ingredients in each wrap.
Drizzle each wrap with jalapeño cheese sauce and Dave's Hot Chicken Sauce to taste.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from bottom to top, tucking as you go.
Cut each wrap in half on the diagonal and serve immediately while the chicken and fries are still hot.
recipes.description: A loaded wrap packed with crispy Nashville hot chicken, creamy coleslaw, Cajun fries, and all the fixings, then drizzled with jalapeño cheese sauce and Dave's hot sauce for serious heat lovers.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Honey Chipotle Burrito
ingredients: 4 oz smoked salmon, torn into pieces
3 strips bacon, cooked crispy and chopped
Jalapeño kettle cooked chips, for serving
directions: Cook bacon until crispy, then chop into pieces. Scramble the eggs in a skillet with a little butter until just set. Keep warm.
Warm the large flour tortilla in a dry skillet or microwave for 20 seconds to make it pliable. Spread cream cheese down the center of the tortilla.
Layer the scrambled eggs, smoked salmon pieces, chopped bacon, and crispy french fries down the center of the tortilla.
Top with avocado slices, red onion, cucumber, tomato, jalapeños, and crumbled feta cheese.
Drizzle honey chipotle sour cream over the filling and sprinkle with fresh parsley.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from bottom to top to form a burrito. Cut in half on the diagonal.
Serve immediately with jalapeño kettle cooked chips on the side.
recipes.description: A loaded breakfast burrito that brings together smoky salmon, crispy bacon, and scrambled eggs with a sweet-heat honey chipotle cream that'll wake up your taste buds. Stuffed with creamy avocado, tangy feta, and even crispy fries inside for that perfect crunch.

recipes.title: Meat Lovers Pizza Burritos
ingredients: 1/2 lb Italian sausage, cooked and crumbled
4 cups crispy garlic parmesan fries, for serving
directions: Cook the Italian sausage in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned and crumbled, then drain. Cook bacon until crispy and crumble. Set meats aside.

In the same skillet, sauté the onions and garlic until softened, about 3 minutes. Add all the cooked meats (sausage, bacon, pepperoni, salami, and ham) along with the tomatoes, jalapeños, pepperoncini, and Italian seasoning. Stir in the vodka or marinara sauce and simmer for 5 minutes.
Warm the tortillas slightly to make them pliable. Lay each tortilla flat and add a generous portion of the meat mixture down the center, leaving space on the edges.
Top the meat with mozzarella cheese, cheddar cheese, and fresh basil. Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from bottom to top to form a burrito.
Optional: Place burritos seam-side down in a hot skillet or on a griddle for 2-3 minutes per side to crisp up the tortilla and melt the cheese.
Serve immediately with crispy garlic parmesan fries and homemade ranch for dipping.
recipes.description: A loaded pizza burrito stuffed with five kinds of meat, melty cheese, and all your favorite pizza toppings wrapped in a tomato basil tortilla. Served with crispy garlic parmesan fries and ranch for dipping — it's like pizza night met burrito night and they had a delicious baby.

recipes.title: Mac and Cheese Loaded Baked Potato Burrito
ingredients: 4 strips bacon, cooked crispy and crumbled
1 1/2 cups crispy french fries, freshly cooked
directions: Warm the flour tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave until pliable. Lay them flat on a clean work surface.
Layer the center of each tortilla with half the pulled pork, pork belly, bacon, cheddar cheese, red onion, tomato, garlic, red pepper, and sauerkraut.
Top each with half the crispy french fries, then drizzle generously with beer cheese sauce and ranch dressing.
Pile on the crushed Cool Ranch Doritos - don't be shy, this is what makes it special.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from bottom to top, tucking as you go to keep all the fillings inside.
Optional: Place the burrito seam-side down in a hot skillet for 2-3 minutes to crisp up the outside and help seal it.
Cut in half diagonally and serve immediately while everything is hot and the fries are still crispy.
recipes.description: This is the ultimate loaded burrito that takes everything you love about a loaded baked potato and wraps it up with smoky pulled pork, crispy fries, and a mountain of Cool Ranch Doritos. It's messy, it's indulgent, and it's absolutely worth every bite.

recipes.title: Creamy Horseradish Steak Burrito
ingredients: 12 oz peppered steak slices (thinly sliced sirloin or ribeye)
directions: Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 8 minutes. Remove, drain on paper towels, and chop into pieces. Cook garlic parmesan fries according to package directions.
In the same skillet with bacon fat, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium-high heat. Season steak slices with salt and pepper, then cook 3-4 minutes until browned. Remove and set aside.
Add remaining olive oil to skillet and sauté mushrooms, onions, jalapeños, and garlic over medium heat for 6-8 minutes until softened and lightly caramelized. Season with salt and pepper.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave for 20 seconds. Spread 2 tablespoons horseradish sauce down the center of each tortilla.
Layer steak slices, bacon, sautéed vegetables, parmesan cheese, pickled red onions, tomato, cucumber, and parsley on each tortilla.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from bottom to top to form a burrito. Optionally, toast the wrapped burrito seam-side down in the skillet for 2 minutes to seal.
Slice each burrito in half and serve immediately with garlic parmesan fries on the side.
recipes.description: A loaded steak burrito packed with peppered beef, crispy bacon, and sautéed veggies, all tied together with tangy creamy horseradish sauce. Served with a side of garlic parmesan fries for the ultimate hearty meal.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie Burrito
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, cooked crispy and chopped
1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup
½ cup sour cream mixed with 2 tablespoons hot sauce
1 cup crushed jalapeño kettle cooked chips
directions: In a large skillet over medium heat, sauté the carrots, celery, and red onions for 5-6 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 1 minute more.

Stir in the chicken, ham, bacon, corn, peas, cream of chicken soup, black pepper, thyme, rosemary, and red chili flakes. Simmer for 8-10 minutes until everything is heated through and the mixture thickens slightly.
Warm the tortillas and lay them flat. Down the center of each, layer the chicken pot pie mixture, shredded cheddar cheese, crispy fries, and crushed jalapeño chips.
Top each burrito with a fried egg, drizzle with hot sauce sour cream, then fold in the sides and roll up tightly. Serve immediately while the fries are still crispy.
recipes.description: A loaded burrito that takes all the comfort of chicken pot pie and wraps it up with crispy fries, bacon, and a fried egg. This is next-level comfort food that eats like a full meal in your hands.

recipes.title: Orange Chicken Burrito
ingredients: 1 lb orange chicken thighs, cooked and chopped
4 oz cream cheese, softened (crab rangoon style)
directions: In a skillet over medium heat, sauté the diced onion, red pepper, green pepper, and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped orange chicken and fried rice to the skillet, stir in half the orange sauce, and heat through for 2-3 minutes.
Warm the tortillas and spread 2 oz cream cheese down the center of each one.
Layer the chicken-rice mixture, Asian sesame slaw, crushed egg rolls, and fried wonton strips on each tortilla.
Drizzle with remaining orange sauce, fold in the sides, and roll up tightly into burritos.
recipes.description: A wild fusion burrito that stuffs all your favorite Chinese takeout into a flour tortilla. Crispy textures, creamy filling, and that sweet orange sauce make this thing absolutely addictive.

recipes.title: Cobb Salad Wrap
ingredients: 4 strips bacon, cooked crispy and chopped
directions: Warm the large flour tortilla in a dry skillet or microwave for 15-20 seconds to make it pliable.
Spread the ranch dressing down the center of the tortilla, leaving about 2 inches on each end.
Layer the ham, bacon, hard boiled eggs, red onion, tomatoes, green pepper, and avocado over the ranch.
Top with blue cheese crumbles, then add the french fries and crushed jalapeño chips for crunch.
Add a splash of Frank's RedHot to taste, then fold in the sides of the tortilla and roll tightly from bottom to top.
Cut the wrap in half diagonally and serve immediately while the fries are still crispy.
recipes.description: A loaded wrap that turns a classic Cobb salad into a handheld meal, packed with ham, bacon, eggs, and veggies, then topped with crispy fries and chips for an over-the-top crunch factor.

recipes.title: Italian Meatball Burrito
ingredients: 1 large tomato basil flour tortilla (12-14 inch)
3 strips bacon, cooked crispy and chopped
1/2 cup provolone cheese, shredded and melted
1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded and melted
1/2 cup sautéed red bell pepper, garlic (3 cloves), onions, and pepperoncini peppers
1 cup garlic parmesan french fries, cooked crispy
3 tablespoons pepperoncini juice Italian herbs mayo
1/2 cup jalapeño kettle chips, lightly crushed
directions: Cook the meatballs according to package directions, then chop into bite-sized pieces. Cook bacon until crispy and chop. Prepare french fries until golden and crispy.
In a skillet over medium heat, sauté red bell pepper, 3 cloves minced garlic, sliced onions, and pepperoncini peppers until softened, about 5-6 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Warm the large tortilla briefly on a griddle or in the microwave. Spread cream cheese down the center, then layer with melted provolone and mozzarella.
Add chopped meatballs, salami, bacon, sautéed vegetables, pickled red onions, coleslaw, and french fries down the center of the tortilla.
Drizzle vodka sauce and pepperoncini juice Italian herbs mayo over the fillings. Top with parmesan, parsley, and basil.
Add crushed jalapeño kettle chips on top for crunch, then fold in the sides of the tortilla and roll tightly into a burrito.
Optional: Place seam-side down on a hot griddle for 2-3 minutes to crisp up the outside and seal the burrito. Cut in half and serve immediately.
recipes.description: A ridiculously loaded Italian-inspired burrito that's got everything — feta-stuffed meatballs, three kinds of cheese, crispy bacon, and even french fries tucked inside. It's messy, it's over-the-top, and it's absolutely worth every bite.

recipes.title: Hot Italian Burrito
ingredients: 4 oz deli ham, sliced and sautéed
4 strips bacon, cooked crispy and chopped
1 medium red onion, sliced and sautéed
1 red bell pepper, sliced and sautéed
1/4 cup mayonnaise mixed with 1 tablespoon Italian herbs
1 cup garlic parmesan french fries, cooked
1/2 cup salt and vinegar kettle chips, crushed
directions: Cook the bacon until crispy, then chop and set aside. In the same pan, sauté the pepperoni, salami, and ham for 2-3 minutes until lightly browned. Remove and keep warm.
Sauté the red onion, red pepper, and garlic in olive oil over medium heat for 5-6 minutes until softened. Season with salt and pepper.
Warm the tortillas and lay them flat. Spread the herb mayo down the center of each, then layer with romaine, tomatoes, pickles, and cherry peppers. Drizzle with red wine vinegar and olive oil.
Add the sautéed meats, bacon, sautéed vegetables, and melted provolone. Dollop whipped feta on top, then add the french fries and crushed kettle chips.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from bottom to top. Cut in half on an angle and serve immediately while everything's still warm and crispy.
recipes.description: A loaded Italian deli-style burrito that's got everything but the kitchen sink — crispy meats, tangy peppers, creamy cheeses, and even french fries stuffed right inside. It's like an Italian sub met a burrito and they had a delicious baby.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato BBQ Steak Burrito
ingredients: 12 oz sliced steak (ribeye or sirloin, thinly sliced)
1 medium yellow onion, sliced and sautéed
1 1/2 cups sweet potato fries (frozen or homemade, cooked crispy)
1/3 cup sour cream mixed with 2 tablespoons BBQ sauce
directions: Cook the bacon in a skillet until crispy, then set aside. In the same skillet, cook the sliced steak over high heat for 3-4 minutes until browned. Season with salt and pepper.
Fry the eggs in a separate pan to your preferred doneness (over-easy or sunny side up works great). Cook or reheat the sweet potato fries until crispy.
Mix the sour cream with BBQ sauce to make BBQ sour cream. Sauté the yellow onions in a bit of oil or butter until soft and golden, about 5-6 minutes.

Warm the tortillas briefly in a dry skillet or microwave. Lay each tortilla flat and layer in the center: steak, bacon (broken into pieces), fried egg, both cheeses, sautéed onions, pickled red onions, tomato, jalapeños, corn relish, and sweet potato fries.
Drizzle generously with BBQ sour cream, then fold in the sides of the tortilla and roll tightly from bottom to top, tucking as you go.
Optional: Toast the wrapped burrito seam-side down in a hot skillet for 1-2 minutes to seal and crisp the outside. Slice in half and serve immediately.
recipes.description: A loaded burrito that's part breakfast, part BBQ feast — packed with sliced steak, bacon, a fried egg, sweet potato fries, and tangy BBQ sour cream. This is the kind of handheld meal that requires both hands and zero shame.

recipes.title: Fried Chicken Gravy and French Fries Burrito
ingredients: 2 fried chicken thighs, chopped into bite-sized pieces
4 strips bacon, cooked crispy and crumbled
1/2 cup corn kernels (canned or frozen, drained)
directions: In a skillet over medium heat, melt butter and sauté the sliced yellow onion and garlic until soft and golden, about 5-7 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside.
Warm the flour tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave until pliable. Lay them flat on a clean surface.
Down the center of each tortilla, layer the chopped fried chicken, French fries, sautéed onions and garlic, corn, red onion, crumbled bacon, and shredded cheddar cheese.
Drizzle about 1/2 cup of warm brown gravy over the fillings in each burrito (don't overdo it or it'll be too messy to wrap).
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from the bottom up, tucking as you go to keep everything secure.
Optional: Toast the wrapped burrito seam-side down in a hot skillet for 2-3 minutes to seal and crisp up the outside.
Slice in half on the diagonal and serve immediately with extra brown gravy on the side for dipping.
recipes.description: This loaded burrito is pure comfort food indulgence — crispy fried chicken, bacon, and French fries all wrapped up with brown gravy, melted cheddar, and sautéed onions. It's messy, it's over-the-top, and it's absolutely worth it.

recipes.title: Sauces
ingredients: For Cowboy Butter: 1 cup butter (softened), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tablespoons fresh parsley (chopped), 1 tablespoon chives (chopped), 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard, salt and pepper to taste
For Garlic Herb Butter: 1 cup butter (softened), 6 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tablespoons mixed fresh herbs (parsley, thyme, rosemary), 1 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
For Tallow Mayo: 1 cup beef tallow (melted and cooled), 2 egg yolks, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard, salt to taste
For Sour Cream Horseradish Sauce: 1 cup sour cream, 3 tablespoons prepared horseradish, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
For Sandwich Sauce: 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 1/4 cup sour cream, 2 tablespoons ketchup, 1 tablespoon sweet pickle relish, 1 teaspoon garlic powder, 1 teaspoon onion powder, salt and pepper to taste
For Tzatziki: 2 cups Greek yogurt, 1 cucumber (grated and squeezed dry), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tablespoons fresh dill (chopped), 1 tablespoon lemon juice, 2 tablespoons olive oil, salt to taste

For Al Pastor Sauce: 1/2 cup pineapple juice, 3 dried guajillo chiles (rehydrated), 3 cloves garlic, 1/4 cup white vinegar, 1 tablespoon achiote paste, 1 teaspoon cumin, 1 teaspoon oregano, salt to taste

For Caesar Vinaigrette: 1/2 cup olive oil, 2 tablespoons lemon juice, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tablespoons Dijon mustard, 1 tablespoon anchovy paste, 1/4 cup grated Parmesan, salt and pepper to taste

For Red Chimichurri Yogurt: 1 cup Greek yogurt, 1/2 cup fresh cilantro (chopped), 1/4 cup fresh parsley (chopped), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar, 1/4 cup olive oil, 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes, juice of 2 lemons, salt to taste
directions: For compound butters (Cowboy and Garlic Herb): Combine softened butter with all ingredients in a bowl, mix thoroughly, shape into a log using plastic wrap, and refrigerate until firm (at least 2 hours).
For Tallow Mayo: Whisk egg yolks with mustard and lemon juice, then slowly drizzle in cooled melted tallow while whisking constantly until emulsified and creamy. Season with salt.

For cold sauces (Sour Cream Horseradish, Sandwich Sauce, Tzatziki, Red Chimichurri Yogurt): Combine all ingredients in a bowl, mix well, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let flavors develop.
For Al Pastor Sauce: Blend rehydrated chiles, garlic, pineapple juice, vinegar, achiote paste, and spices until smooth. Simmer in a small saucepan for 10 minutes, then strain if desired.
For Caesar Vinaigrette: Whisk together garlic, mustard, anchovy paste, and lemon juice, then slowly drizzle in olive oil while whisking constantly. Stir in Parmesan and season to taste.
Taste all sauces and adjust seasoning as needed — add more salt, acid (lemon/vinegar), or spices to suit your preference.
Store all sauces in airtight containers in the refrigerator. Compound butters keep for 2 weeks, mayo-based sauces for 3-5 days, and yogurt-based sauces for up to 1 week.
recipes.description: A collection of versatile homemade sauces perfect for topping everything from steaks and burgers to tacos and salads. Mix and match these flavor-packed condiments to elevate any meal.

recipes.title: Steak and Creamed Spinach Burrito
directions: Cook bacon in a skillet until crispy, then set aside. In the same pan with 1 tablespoon butter, sauté mushrooms, onions, red peppers, and garlic over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes until softened. Season with salt, pepper, parsley, and thyme. Remove and keep warm.
In the same skillet, cook the sliced peppered steak for 2-3 minutes per side until heated through and edges are slightly crispy. Set aside and keep warm.
Fry the egg in remaining butter to your preferred doneness (over-easy recommended for a runny yolk). Meanwhile, warm the flour tortilla in a dry skillet or microwave for 20 seconds until pliable.
Spread cream cheese down the center of the tortilla, then layer with creamed spinach, steak, bacon, sautéed vegetables, and the fried egg. Top with Parmesan cheese and fried onion strings.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from bottom to top, tucking as you go. Cut in half on a diagonal.
Serve immediately with garlic Parmesan fries, jalapeño chips, and peppercorn steak sauce on the side for dipping.
recipes.description: This loaded breakfast burrito is a serious meal — peppered steak, crispy bacon, creamed spinach, and a fried egg all wrapped up with sautéed veggies and topped with crunchy onion strings. Served with garlic parm fries and that peppercorn steak sauce for dipping, it's basically brunch and dinner had a delicious baby.

recipes.title: Big Mac Burrito
directions: Cook french fries according to package directions until crispy, then season with garlic salt and pepper while hot. Set aside.
Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks. Season with salt and pepper, then drain excess grease.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave until pliable. Lay each tortilla flat and spread 2-3 tablespoons Big Mac sauce down the center.
Layer each tortilla with seasoned beef, a handful of fries, cheddar cheese, red and white onions, pickles, tomatoes, and lettuce.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from bottom to top to form a burrito.
Optional: Place burritos seam-side down in a hot skillet for 1-2 minutes per side to crisp the outside and melt the cheese.
Cut in half and serve with kettle cooked chips on the side and extra Big Mac sauce for dipping.
recipes.description: All the flavors of a Big Mac wrapped up in a loaded burrito with seasoned fries, cheese, and that iconic special sauce. This is fast food mashup heaven that'll make you forget about the drive-thru.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Burrito
ingredients: 4 oz smoked thick cut ham, diced
3 strips bacon, cooked crispy and chopped
directions: Cook the bacon until crispy, then chop and set aside. In the same pan, cook the diced ham until lightly browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Fry 2 eggs to your liking (over easy or scrambled works great). Season with salt and pepper.
Mix the mayo and sour cream together in a small bowl. Warm the tortilla in a dry skillet or microwave for 20 seconds to make it pliable.
Spread the mayo-sour cream mixture down the center of the tortilla. Layer on the ham, bacon, both cheeses, pickles, jalapeño, and onion.
Top with the fried eggs, then add the french fries and crushed chips for crunch.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll it up tightly from bottom to top, tucking as you go.
Optional: Place the burrito seam-side down in a hot skillet for 1-2 minutes per side to crisp up the outside and melt the cheese even more.
recipes.description: A loaded breakfast burrito that's stuffed with everything good — smoky ham, crispy bacon, melted cheese, fried eggs, and even french fries for that perfect crunch. This is the kind of hearty wrap that'll keep you going all day.

recipes.title: Cheesy Chipotle Lime Chicken Burrito
ingredients: 1 lb chicken thighs, seasoned with 2 tablespoons chipotle seasoning
4 eggs, scrambled with 2 oz goat cheese
1 (4 oz) can diced green chilies, drained
1 cup black beans, drained and rinsed
2 cups chile lime seasoned french fries, cooked crispy
1/2 cup sour cream mixed with 3 tablespoons chipotle sauce
directions: Cook bacon until crispy, then chop into pieces. Season chicken thighs with chipotle seasoning and cook in a skillet over medium-high heat until fully cooked and slightly charred, about 6-8 minutes per side. Slice into strips.

Sauté sliced onion, red bell pepper, and minced garlic in a skillet with a little oil until softened and caramelized, about 8-10 minutes. In a separate pan, scramble eggs with goat cheese until just set.
Warm black beans in a small pot. Cook french fries according to package directions until extra crispy, then toss with chile lime seasoning. Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave until pliable.

Lay out tortilla and layer ingredients down the center: goat cheese scrambled eggs, sliced chipotle chicken, bacon pieces, sautéed vegetables, black beans, Mexican cheese, feta, green chilies, pickled onions, raw jalapeños, and crispy fries.
Top with guacamole, cilantro, drizzle with lime juice and chipotle sour cream, then add fried onion strips and crushed Takis for crunch.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from bottom to top, tucking as you go. Cut in half on an angle and serve immediately while everything is still warm and crispy.
recipes.description: This is the ultimate loaded burrito — crispy bacon, smoky chipotle chicken, creamy cheeses, and crunchy Takis all wrapped up in one ridiculously satisfying package. It's got everything from pickled onions to fried onion strips, because why choose when you can have it all?

recipes.title: Pastrami Ground Beef Chili  Burrito
ingredients: 2 cups ground beef chili (homemade or canned)
1 cup parsley french fries, cooked crispy
1 cup Fritos or Chili Cheese Fritos
directions: Cook bacon until crispy and crumble; chop pastrami into bite-sized pieces. Warm ground beef chili in a pot over medium heat.
In a small bowl, mix together mayonnaise, yellow mustard, and sour cream to make the sauce. Set aside.
Warm flour tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave until pliable. Spread a thin layer of cream cheese down the center of each tortilla.
Layer pastrami, bacon, hot chili, corn, both onions, pickles, jalapeños, and pepperoncini down the center of each tortilla.
Top with cheddar cheese, a handful of crispy french fries, and Fritos. Drizzle with the mayo-mustard-sour cream sauce.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from bottom to top, tucking as you go to keep everything inside.
Optional: Place burrito seam-side down in a hot skillet for 1-2 minutes per side to crisp up and seal the tortilla.
recipes.description: A massive loaded burrito stuffed with smoky pastrami, bacon, hearty ground beef chili, and all the fixings — crispy fries, Fritos, and tangy pickled peppers make this the ultimate comfort food mashup.

recipes.title: Pastrami Ruben Burrito
ingredients: 1/4 cup thinly sliced raw red onion
1 cup frozen French fries, cooked and seasoned with salt, pepper, thyme, and sugar
1/2 cup salt and vinegar kettle chips
directions: Cook the bacon until crispy, then cook the French fries according to package directions and season generously with salt, pepper, thyme, and a pinch of sugar while hot.
Warm the tortilla in a dry skillet or microwave until pliable. Layer the pastrami in the center, then top with the crispy bacon pieces.
Sprinkle both melted cheeses over the meat while still hot, then add the drained sauerkraut, pickles, red onion, and green chiles.
Add the seasoned French fries and kettle chips right on top of everything, then drizzle with Thousand Island dressing.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from the bottom up, tucking as you go to keep everything contained.
Optional: Place the burrito seam-side down in a hot skillet for 1-2 minutes to seal and crisp up the outside before serving.
recipes.description: A monster mash-up that takes everything you love about a pastrami Reuben and wraps it up burrito-style with crispy fries and chips tucked inside. It's messy, indulgent, and absolutely worth every napkin you'll go through.

recipes.title: Pastrami Breakfast Burrito
ingredients: 3 strips bacon, cooked crispy and chopped
1/4 cup sautéed onions and garlic (about 1/2 medium onion and 2 cloves garlic)
1/2 cup frozen french fries, cooked crispy
directions: Cook the bacon until crispy, then chop and set aside. Cook the french fries according to package directions until golden and crispy.
Scramble the eggs with the goat cheese crumbles in a skillet over medium heat until just set but still creamy. Set aside and keep warm.
In a small bowl, mix together the sour cream, mayonnaise, and hot sauce to make the sauce. Set aside.

Warm the tortilla in a dry skillet or microwave for 20 seconds until pliable. Layer the spinach down the center, then add the scrambled eggs, pastrami, bacon, french fries, sautéed onions and garlic, tomatoes, green chilies, and pickled red onions.
Top with cheddar cheese, cottage cheese, and drizzle with the hot sauce mayo.

Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from bottom to top to form a burrito. Place seam-side down in a hot skillet for 1-2 minutes to seal and crisp up the outside if desired. Serve immediately.
recipes.description: This isn't your average breakfast burrito — it's loaded with pastrami, bacon, crispy fries, and goat cheese scrambled eggs, then topped with a tangy hot sauce mayo that'll wake you right up. A hearty Southern-style monster that's perfect for weekend mornings when you're really hungry.
